paragraphs.en: How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents) , which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent’s continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%–54.7% token reduction, 1.8 × \times –2.6 × \times faster inference, and 2.7 × \times –3.7 × \times cost savings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们如何构建一个能够超越人类语言进行思考，但仍能通过语言在外部环境中行动的智能体？ 现代大型语言模型智能体仍然通过文本进行推理和交互，而潜在推理虽然提供了一种高效的内部媒介，却缺乏对工具的天然访问能力和推理透明度。 我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）架起了这两个方向的桥梁，该智能体在整个统一的生成过程中动态地在潜在推理和基于文本的交互之间切换。 在架构上，一个轻量级的 HybridLink 实现了文本模式与潜在模式之间的无缝转换，而智能体的持续工作记忆则确保了多轮交互中混合上下文信息的无损保留。 这些设计既保留了集成工具的智能体能力，又使得潜在思维过程可以直接被观察和检查。 基于这一架构，我们进一步开发了针对混合推理的专用后训练算法：HybridSFT 通过训练主干模型与 HybridLink 协同工作，稳定了集成工具的混合生成；随后，HybridRL 通过学习在何时使用潜在空间进行思考、何时通过文本采取行动，提升了推理能力。 我们在 3 种不同规模的模型上，针对涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理的 11 项基准测试对 HybridAgent 进行了评估。 与前沿大型语言模型智能体以及同时支持文本和潜在方法的智能体框架相比，HybridAgent 的性能始终提升 10.4%，同时将令牌使用量减少了 35.5%–54.7%，推理速度提升了 1.8 × –2.6 ×，并实现了 2.7 × –3.7 × 的成本节约。

paragraphs.en: Frontier intelligence no longer scales through the model’s reasoning alone, but depends increasingly on its ability to interact with the external world ( Team, 2026 ; Kwa et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ) . To solve a hard problem, an LLM agent must reach beyond the model itself by continually invoking specialized tools, observing feedback from the environment, and adapting its next move ( Qu et al., 2025 ; Silver and Sutton, 2025 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . Beneath this expanding repertoire of agent harnesses lies a single lingua franca: text , the common medium of both the agent’s autoregressive generation and its environment interaction ( Sumers et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . All intermediate reasoning trajectories are generated token by token as text before the agent can act on the environment.
paragraphs.zh: 前沿智能体的能力不再仅通过模型本身的推理来扩展，而是越来越依赖于其与外部世界互动的能力（Team, 2026；Kwa et al., 2026；Sun et al., 2026）。 要解决一个难题，LLM 智能体必须超越模型本身，通过持续调用专用工具、观察环境反馈并调整下一步行动来实现（Qu et al., 2025；Silver and Sutton, 2025；Feng et al., 2026）。 在这些不断扩展的智能体能力背后，存在一种统一的通用语言：文本，它既是智能体自回归生成的共同媒介，也是其与环境互动的共同媒介（Sumers et al., 2024；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 所有中间推理路径都以文本形式逐个词元生成，之后智能体才能对环境采取行动。

paragraphs.en: A separate line of work on latent reasoning points in a different direction ( Zhu et al., 2025b ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . By unfolding computation directly in continuous hidden space, latent models bypass the need to decode and verbalize every intermediate step, providing more efficient internal reasoning within the model’s “own language" ( Hao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2026 ) . However, today’s latent reasoners remain largely sealed behind the model boundary. Unlike decoded text, continuous latent vectors (i) lack native pathways for tool invocation across multi-turn agentic reasoning ( Chang et al., 2026 ) , and (ii) do not readily expose human-interpretable semantics, leaving them difficult to supervise during training ( Chen et al., 2026 ) and to audit or debug at inference ( Korbak et al., 2025 ) . These constraints keep latent reasoning models from operating as capable agents in their own right.
paragraphs.zh: 关于潜在推理的独立研究则指向了另一个方向（Zhu 等人，2025b；Chen 等人，2025）。 通过在连续隐藏空间中直接展开计算，潜在模型无需对每个中间步骤进行解码和语言化，从而在模型的“自身语言”内部实现了更高效的推理（Hao 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2025；Yu 等人，2026）。 然而，当前的潜在推理模型在很大程度上仍被封闭在模型边界之内。 与解码后的文本不同，连续潜在向量（i）缺乏在多轮智能体推理中调用工具的原生路径（Chang 等人，2026），且（ii）无法轻易暴露人类可解释的语义，这使得它们在训练期间难以监督（Chen 等人，2026），在推理阶段也难以审计或调试（Korbak 等人，2025）。 这些限制导致潜在推理模型尚无法独立地作为能力强大的智能体运行。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, agentic interaction and efficient inner reasoning have so far required a different medium each, leaving the two lines of work apart in the development of next-generation agents. We believe this division can be closed by building a new type of agent that combines both strengths to think beyond text while still acting through it . We call this unified design HybridAgent , one that dynamically navigates between latent reasoning and text-based interaction within a single generation.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，智能体交互与高效的内部推理迄今为止各自都需要不同的媒介，这使得这两条研究路线在下一代智能体的开发中相互分离。 我们相信，通过构建一种新型智能体，可以弥合这种分歧——它将两者的优势相结合，既能超越文本进行思考，又能继续通过文本执行操作。 我们将这种统一设计称为 HybridAgent，它能够在单次生成过程中动态地在潜在推理与基于文本的交互之间切换。

sents.zh: 我们相信，通过构建一种新型智能体，可以弥合这种分歧——它将两者的优势相结合，既能超越文本进行思考，又能继续通过文本执行操作。

sents.en: We call this unified design HybridAgent , one that dynamically navigates between latent reasoning and text-based interaction within a single generation.
sents.zh: 我们将这种统一设计称为 HybridAgent，它能够在单次生成过程中动态地在潜在推理与基于文本的交互之间切换。

paragraphs.en: Building such an agent is hard, since it needs to handle both dense continuous vectors and sparse discrete tokens as hybrid inputs, and determine when to transition between text and latent modes to balance agentic actions and reasoning efficiency. To offset the hardness, we first revisit the model architecture and extend its autoregressive generation interface to support hybrid inputs. At the heart of this design is HybridLink , a lightweight residual adapter that bridges latent thoughts from the last-layer hidden space back into the input embedding space and enables sequence-wise recurrence within latent mode. Then, we realize multi-turn hybrid generation through the agent’s own working memory, carrying complete hybrid trajectories of text, latent thoughts, and tool observations across turns. Surprisingly, we find that HybridAgent can render its thoughts in latent mode as human-readable pseudo-text, making latent reasoning transparent and directly inspectable rather than opaque.
paragraphs.zh: 构建这样一个智能体十分困难，因为它需要处理密集连续向量和稀疏离散标记作为混合输入，并决定何时在文本模式与潜在模式之间切换，以平衡智能体行为与推理效率。 为缓解这一难题，我们首先重新审视模型架构，并将其自回归生成接口扩展至支持混合输入。 该设计的核心是 HybridLink——一个轻量级残差适配器，它能够将最后一层隐藏空间中的潜在思维桥接回输入嵌入空间，并实现潜在模式内的序列式循环。 接着，我们通过智能体自身的工作记忆实现了多轮混合生成，使文本、潜在思维与工具观察结果在整个交互过程中保持完整的混合轨迹。 令人意外的是，我们发现 HybridAgent 能够以人类可读的伪文本形式呈现其潜在模式中的思维，从而使潜在推理变得透明且可直接检验，而非不透明。

paragraphs.en: To further unlock the potential of hybrid reasoning, we equip HybridAgent with dedicated post-training algorithms. HybridSFT first stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation through activation and self-conditioned training, which adapts the backbone to reason over latent thoughts produced by its own HybridLink, enabling reliable coordination between the two components and closing the train-inference mismatch. Then, HybridRL scales agentic reasoning capabilities by training HybridAgent to adaptively balance latent reasoning and text-based interaction. To realize this, we enable policy optimization over hybrid trajectories through hybrid policy factorization and exact rollout replay.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步释放混合推理的潜力，我们为 HybridAgent 配备了专门的后续训练算法。 HybridSFT 首先通过激活和自条件训练来稳定工具集成的混合生成过程，这一过程使主干模型能够对其自身 HybridLink 产生的潜在思维进行推理，从而实现两个组件之间的可靠协调，并消除训练与推理之间的不匹配问题。 接着，HybridRL 通过训练 HybridAgent 自适应地平衡潜在推理和基于文本的交互，来扩展智能体的推理能力。 为实现这一点，我们通过混合策略分解和精确的滚动重播，使策略能够在混合轨迹上进行优化。

paragraphs.en: We provide theoretical grounding for HybridAgent through complementary analyses of multi-turn context continuation and hybrid policy optimization. From an architectural standpoint, we show that continuous working memory losslessly preserves the entire hybrid context across different turns. From a learning perspective, the hybrid policy factorization and exact latent-context replay in HybridRL provide a well-founded basis for policy updates over complete hybrid trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过多轮上下文延续和混合策略优化的互补性分析，为 HybridAgent 提供了理论依据。 从架构角度来看，我们证明了持续的工作记忆能够无损地保留不同轮次中的整个混合上下文。 从学习角度来看，HybridRL 中的混合策略分解以及对潜在上下文的精确重放，为完整混合轨迹上的策略更新提供了坚实的理论基础。

sents.en: We provide theoretical grounding for HybridAgent through complementary analyses of multi-turn context continuation and hybrid policy optimization.
sents.zh: 我们通过多轮上下文延续和混合策略优化的互补性分析，为 HybridAgent 提供了理论依据。

sents.en: From an architectural standpoint, we show that continuous working memory losslessly preserves the entire hybrid context across different turns.
sents.zh: 从架构角度来看，我们证明了持续的工作记忆能够无损地保留不同轮次中的整个混合上下文。

sents.en: From a learning perspective, the hybrid policy factorization and exact latent-context replay in HybridRL provide a well-founded basis for policy updates over complete hybrid trajectories.
sents.zh: 从学习角度来看，HybridRL 中的混合策略分解以及对潜在上下文的精确重放，为完整混合轨迹上的策略更新提供了坚实的理论基础。

paragraphs.en: Empirically, we evaluate HybridAgent on 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, science, medicine, knowledge-intensive search, and challenging agentic reasoning. We instantiate and train HybridAgent with Qwen3-Base models ( Yang et al., 2025a ) across 4B, 8B, and 14B scales. Compared with frontier LLM agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent reasoning, HybridAgent achieves an average performance improvement of 10.4% and exhibits strong test-time scalability. In terms of efficiency, HybridAgent reduces token usage by 35.5%–54.7%, delivers 1.8 × \times –2.6 × \times inference speedup, and lowers computational cost by 2.7 × \times –3.7 × \times . Additional in-depth analyses of training dynamics, reasoning auditability, and agentic tool-use reliability reveal a clear division of labor between the two reasoning modes: HybridAgent shifts more internal reasoning into semantically rich and interpretable latent thoughts, while reserving text for external inspection and tool interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实证方法，在涵盖数学、科学、医学、知识密集型搜索以及具有挑战性的智能体推理的 11 个基准测试上对 HybridAgent 进行了评估。 我们使用 Qwen3-Base 模型（Yang et al., 2025a）对 HybridAgent 进行实例化和训练，其规模涵盖 4B、8B 和 14B。 与前沿 LLM 智能体以及涵盖文本推理和潜在推理的智能体框架相比，HybridAgent 的平均性能提升了 10.4%，并展现出强大的测试时扩展能力。 在效率方面，HybridAgent 将令牌使用量减少了 35.5%–54.7%，推理速度提升了 1.8 × –2.6 ×，并将计算成本降低了 2.7 × –3.7 ×。 对训练动态、推理可审计性以及智能体工具使用可靠性的进一步深度分析表明，两种推理模式之间存在明确的分工：HybridAgent 将更多内部推理转化为语义丰富且可解释的潜在思维，而将文本保留用于外部检查与工具交互。

paragraphs.en: We introduce HybridAgent, a hybrid framework that dynamically navigates between explicit text and continuous latent reasoning within a single unified generation process. As illustrated in Figure 1 , the architecture preserves an LLM agent’s autoregressive generation and tool-calling interfaces while accommodating both text and latent inputs. Below, we first present the hybrid interface for seamless text-latent mode transition (Section 3.1 ), followed by multi-turn hybrid generation (Section 3.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HybridAgent，这是一种混合框架，能够在单一统一的生成过程中动态地在显式文本与连续潜在推理之间切换。 如图 1 所示，该架构保留了 LLM 智能体的自回归生成和工具调用接口，同时支持文本输入和潜在输入。 下文首先介绍实现文本与潜在模式无缝切换的混合接口（第 3.1 节），随后阐述多轮混合生成（第 3.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: Existing latent reasoning models typically feed the last-layer hidden state h t h_{t} directly back as the next-step input e t + 1 e_{t+1} . This design is not well suited to hybrid generation, as substituting h t h_{t} for a token embedding creates a representation mismatch with the pretrained input space, making transitions between continuous latent states and discrete tokens difficult. To support both latent and text modes in a shared input interface, we add a lightweight adapter HybridLink to work alongside the backbone.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的潜在推理模型通常将最后一层的隐藏状态 h t h_{t} 直接作为下一步输入 e t + 1 e_{t+1} 反馈回去。 这种设计并不适合混合生成，因为用 h t h_{t} 替代词元嵌入会导致与预训练输入空间之间的表示不匹配，从而使得连续潜在状态与离散词元之间的转换变得困难。 为了在共享的输入接口中同时支持潜在模式和文本模式，我们添加了一个轻量级的适配器 HybridLink，使其与主干模型协同工作。

paragraphs.en: In text mode, HybridAgent behaves exactly as a standard LLM, sampling the next token from the vocabulary at each step. The process continues until the agent generates one special token <latent> , which serves as the entry anchor for the latent mode. For the next forward pass, the agent uses HybridLink for latent reasoning in place of the LM head and token embedding layer.
paragraphs.zh: 在文本模式下，HybridAgent 的行为与标准 LLM 完全相同，每一步都从词汇表中采样下一个词元。 该过程将持续进行，直到智能体生成一个特殊词元 <latent>，它作为潜模式入口的锚点。 在随后的前向传播中，智能体将使用 HybridLink 替代语言模型头层和词元嵌入层来进行潜在推理。

At each step, the agent adaptively decides whether to remain in its current mode or switch, allowing the length and frequency of text and latent spans to emerge dynamically rather than follow preset configurations.
paragraphs.zh: HybridAgent 随后会返回其文本模式，并且在生成过程中这种转换会持续进行。 在每个步骤中，智能体都会自适应地决定是保持在当前模式还是进行切换，从而使得文本和潜在片段的出现长度与频率能够动态形成，而不是遵循预设的配置。

paragraphs.en: Interpretable Latent Mode. During hybrid generation, a useful property of HybridAgent is that its latent mode remains decoding-free yet directly interpretable. To inspect any latent reasoning span, one can easily recover its semantics by mapping each latent step produced by HybridLink to its nearest token embedding, as in Eq. 5 . We illustrate this interpretability property clearly in Figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 可解释的潜在模式。 在混合生成过程中，HybridAgent 的一个有用特性是：其潜在模式无需解码，且可以直接被解释。 要检查任何潜在的推理片段，可以通过将 HybridLink 生成的每个潜在步骤映射到其最近的词元嵌入来轻松恢复其语义，如公式 5 所示。 我们在图 2 中清晰地展示了这种可解释性特性。

sents.en: Interpretable Latent Mode.
sents.zh: 可解释的潜在模式。

paragraphs.en: In standard LLM agents, each turn’s generated content and tool outputs are appended to the textual context and re-encoded as the next turn’s input prefix. Hybrid trajectories, however, interleave text tokens with latent vectors and can’t be reconstructed through conventional tokenization alone. Instead, HybridAgent carries the complete context across turns through its continuous working memory.
paragraphs.zh: 在标准的 LLM 智能体中，每一轮生成的内容和工具输出都会被追加到文本上下文中，并重新编码为下一轮的输入前缀。 然而，混合轨迹将文本标记与潜在向量交错排列，无法仅通过传统的分词方法重建。 相反，HybridAgent 通过其连续的工作记忆在每一轮之间传递完整的上下文。

sents.en: Hybrid trajectories, however, interleave text tokens with latent vectors and can’t be reconstructed through conventional tokenization alone.

sents.en: Instead, HybridAgent carries the complete context across turns through its continuous working memory.
sents.zh: 相反，HybridAgent 通过其连续的工作记忆在每一轮之间传递完整的上下文。

paragraphs.en: Cross-Turn Working Memory. Recall that a single-turn hybrid trajectory τ \tau in Eq. 3 consists of model-generated text, latent thoughts, and external tool interactions. During input construction, all contents are mapped into the same input space through either the input embedding layer or HybridLink. This shared space allows the Transformer to process all three components uniformly and collect their KV entries throughout generation. We leverage these accumulated KV entries as the HybridAgent’s continuous working memory to achieve multi-turn hybrid generation.
paragraphs.zh: 跨回合工作记忆。 回顾一下，公式 3 中的单回合混合轨迹 τ \tau 由模型生成的文本、潜在思想和外部工具交互组成。 在输入构建过程中，所有内容都通过输入嵌入层或 HybridLink 映射到同一个输入空间。 这个共享空间使得 Transformer 能够统一处理这三个组件，并在整个生成过程中收集它们的 KV 条目。 我们利用这些累积的 KV 条目作为 HybridAgent 的连续工作记忆，以实现多回合混合生成。

paragraphs.en: With the overall framework in place, we now turn to training. As HybridAgent leaves the backbone architecture intact, no pre-training from scratch is required. Instead, we adapt the standard agentic post-training pipeline of supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to the hybrid setting. The two training stages serve complementary roles: SFT teaches the agent to coordinate with HybridLink and instantiate reliable tool use for stable hybrid generation (Section 4.1 ), while RL further scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text (Section 4.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 整体框架已经搭建完毕，我们现在转向训练阶段。 由于 HybridAgent 保留了骨干架构的完整性，因此无需从头开始进行预训练。 相反，我们将标准的智能体后训练流程——即监督微调与强化学习——适配到混合设置中。 这两个训练阶段发挥着互补的作用：SFT 教导智能体如何与 HybridLink 协调，并实现可靠的工具使用，从而确保稳定的混合生成（第 4.1 节）；而 RL 则通过学习何时在潜在空间中思考、何时通过文本执行操作，进一步提升了推理能力（第 4.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: As a first step toward stabilizing hybrid reasoning in HybridAgent, we design the entire HybridSFT stage through a hybrid data curation pipeline and a staged training procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 作为在 HybridAgent 中稳定混合推理的第一步，我们通过混合数据策展流程分阶段训练程序来设计整个 HybridSFT 阶段。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid Data Recipe. To curate high-quality training data, we filter existing text-based agentic SFT datasets from multiple sources and convert them into hybrid trajectories through automatic annotation. We assign reasoning steps to latent mode based on both LLM Experts’ judgments and target models’ own prediction entropy, while retaining a small set of key steps for tool interactions and external debugging/auditing in text mode (see Appendix E for data curation details).
paragraphs.zh: 混合数据配方。 为了整理高质量训练数据，我们从多个来源筛选现有的基于文本的智能体 SFT 数据集，并通过自动标注将其转换为混合轨迹。 我们根据 LLM 专家的判断以及目标模型自身的预测熵值，将推理步骤分配给潜在模式，同时保留少量用于工具交互和外部调试/审计的关键步骤在文本模式中（有关数据整理的详细信息，请参见附录 E）。

paragraphs.en: where π θ , π θ old \pi_{\theta},\pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} denote the current and rollout policies. At latent positions, however, HybridAgent generates continuous vectors rather than sampled tokens, leaving no token-level likelihood. Thus, the importance ratio ρ t \rho_{t} is undefined. paragraphs.en: Hybrid Policy Factorization. Recall that, in a hybrid trajectory, latent thoughts are computed entirely in the continuous latent space through HybridLink, and tool responses are the masked observations from the environment. Thus, policy sampling during rollout is confined to model-generated text positions. To justify why policy optimization needs only to operate over these sampled positions, we formalize the hybrid policy factorization below with detailed theoretical analyses.

paragraphs.en: Policy Update via Exact Rollout Replay. Policy optimization generally involves rebuilding a differentiable computation graph for the rollouts. Applying this to HybridAgent further requires recomputing sampled text-token likelihoods conditioned on the same preceding latent thoughts used during rollout. paragraphs.en: Tasks and Datasets. We conduct comprehensive evaluations of HybridAgent on 11 benchmarks across various domains: (i) Mathematical Reasoning , including AIME 25 ( math-ai, 2025 ) , AIME 26 ( MathArena, 2026 ) , and MATH500 ( HuggingFaceH4, 2023 ) ; (ii) Knowledge-Intensive Reasoning , including GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) , MedQA ( Yang et al., 2024 ) , and MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) ; and (iii) Agentic Reasoning , including General AI Assistants (GAIA) ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) , Humanity’s Last Exam (HLE) ( Center for AI Safety et al., 2026 ) , WebWalker ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) , and DeepSearchQA (DSQA) ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) . We adopt the standard evaluation metric for each dataset. Additional benchmark details are in Appendix H.1 .

paragraphs.en: Models and Training Setups. We instantiate HybridAgent with Qwen3-Base backbones ( Yang et al., 2025a ) at three scales of 4B, 8B, and 14B. During RL, we set rollout batches of 512 trajectories ( 64 × 8 64\times 8 ), followed by one optimization pass over 8 minibatches.

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. HybridAgent interacts with external environments primarily through two types of tools: a Python interpreter within sandbox environments and a live search engine (e.g., Tavily). We cap tool usage at 10 calls per trajectory and retrieve the top 10 snippets for each search query. As current serving engines do not support multi-turn hybrid generation, we extend the training and inference infrastructure to enable text, latent, and tool-calling transitions and persistent KV working-memory transfer. RL rollouts use a sampling temperature of 1.0, and evaluation uses temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, and top-k 20. We conduct experiments on H100 GPUs using five independent seeds. Additional training/inference details and hyperparameter setups are provided in Appendix H.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。 HybridAgent主要通过两种工具与外部环境进行交互：沙盒环境中的Python解释器和实时搜索引擎（例如Tavily）。 我们将每个轨迹的工具使用次数限制为10次，并为每个搜索查询检索前10个片段。 由于当前的推理引擎不支持多轮混合生成，我们扩展了训练和推理基础设施，以实现文本、潜在表示和工具调用的转换，以及持久的KV工作记忆传输。 RL展开使用采样温度1.0，而评估则使用温度0.6、top-p 0.95和top-k 20。 我们在H100 GPU上，使用五个独立的随机种子进行实验。 额外的训练/推理细节和超参数设置见附录H.3。

paragraphs.en: Main Results. Tables 1 and 2 report the overall performance of HybridAgent across 11 benchmarks spanning math, science, medicine, and knowledge search domains. On challenging agentic reasoning benchmarks, HybridAgent delivers competitive performance over larger frontier LLM agents and specialized tool-use frameworks, with HybridAgent (14B) improving over the strongest agentic baseline by an average of 17.4%. In addition, under matched model sizes and training budgets, HybridSFT and HybridRL demonstrate consistent training effectiveness and improve over corresponding text/latent baselines by 18.5% at the SFT stage and 10.4% at the RL stage. Together, HybridAgent combines the strengths of text-based agentic tool use with faster and more expressive latent reasoning, allowing the agent to interact externally while achieving deeper thinking depth internally.

To further examine the test-time scalability of our hybrid reasoning paradigm, we increase inference compute budgets through additional sampling and evaluate pass@k performance. paragraphs.en: Beyond performance effectiveness, a key architectural advantage of HybridAgent is that latent mode enables efficient generation without costly explicit token decoding. We evaluate this property empirically along three complementary dimensions: (i) token throughput , (ii) wall-clock inference time , and (iii) actual computation cost . As shown in Figures 6 and 7 , HybridAgent adaptively balances its hybrid reasoning across text and latent modes by using 2.7 × 2.7\times fewer text tokens, reducing total generation steps by up to 54%, and achieving 2.1 × 2.1\times faster inference than text-based baselines. Together with the cost analyses in Table 9 (see Appendix G.2 ), HybridAgent generates more concise and refined reasoning trajectories, reducing inference overhead and cost.
paragraphs.zh: 除了性能有效性之外，HybridAgent 的一个关键架构优势在于，其潜在模式能够高效生成内容，而无需耗费大量成本的显式令牌解码。 我们从三个互补的维度对这一特性进行了实证评估：(i) 令牌吞吐量，(ii) 实际推理时间，以及 (iii) 实际计算成本。 如图 6 和图 7 所示，HybridAgent 通过减少 2.7 × 2.7\times 的文本令牌数量，自适应地平衡了其在文本模式和潜在模式之间的混合推理，从而将总生成步骤最多减少了 54%，并比基于文本的基线模型实现了 2.1 × 2.1\times 更快的推理速度。 结合表 9 中的成本分析（参见附录 G.2），HybridAgent 能够生成更简洁、更精细的推理路径，从而降低了推理的额外开销和成本。

paragraphs.en: RoadMap. We further analyze HybridAgent from 3 complementary perspectives to assess the method design and better understand its hybrid reasoning behavior. (i) Training Dynamics : We study how self-conditioning in HybridSFT improves reasoning performance (Table 8 ) and latent interpretability (Figure 8 ), and how HybridRL shifts more reasoning into latent mode while strengthening tool interaction (Figure 9 ). (ii) Latent-Mode : We intervene on latent content, ordering, and reasoning depth to examine HybridAgent’s causal reliance on latent thoughts (Table 5 ), and ablate HybridLink architectures to assess the benefits of residual alignment (Table 6 ). (iii) Text-Mode : We evaluate text-based agentic tool use (Figure 10 ) and auditability of HybridAgent (Table 7 ) to verify that text-mode supports reliable environment interaction and remains informative for external monitoring/debugging.
paragraphs.zh: RoadMap。 我们从三个互补的视角进一步分析 HybridAgent，以评估该方法的设计并更好地理解其混合推理行为。 (i) 训练动态：我们研究 HybridSFT 中的自我条件化如何提升推理性能（表 8）和潜在可解释性（图 8），以及 HybridRL 如何将更多推理转移到潜在模式，同时增强工具交互（图 9）。 (ii) 潜在模式：我们通过干预潜在内容、顺序和推理深度，考察 HybridAgent 对潜在思维的因果依赖（表 5），并消融 HybridLink 架构以评估残差对齐带来的益处（表 6）。 (iii) 文本模式：我们评估基于文本的智能体工具使用（图 10）以及 HybridAgent 的可审计性（表 7），以验证文本模式能否支持可靠的环境交互，并在外部监控/调试时保持信息丰富。

paragraphs.en: Self-Conditioning Enables Effective and Interpretable HybridSFT. To understand why self-conditioned training is necessary for HybridAgent during SFT, we compare HybridSFT against variants with only format and HybridLink activations as well as latent SFT baselines like Coconut, from both performance and interpretability perspectives. As shown in Table 8 , although all SFT variants improve the original shared Qwen3-14B-Base backbone, activation alone remains insufficient. Self-conditioned supervision further improves performance by an average of 30.5% over HybridLink activation, bringing HybridSFT to parity with standard text SFT across all three math benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 自我条件化使高效且可解释的 HybridSFT 成为可能。 为了解为何在 SFT 期间，HybridAgent 需要自我条件化训练，我们从性能和可解释性两个角度，将 HybridSFT 与仅包含格式和 HybridLink 激活的变体，以及像 Coconut 这样的潜在 SFT 基线进行了比较。 如表 8 所示，尽管所有 SFT 变体都优于原始的共享 Qwen3-14B-Base 基础模型，但仅靠激活仍然不足。 自我条件化监督在性能上进一步提升了 30.5%（相对于 HybridLink 激活），使 HybridSFT 在所有三个数学基准测试中达到了与标准文本 SFT 相当的水平。

paragraphs.en: We further probe the semantics of the latent thoughts produced by each method over 200 questions spanning all downstream domains. Figure 8 reveals a clear progression, where HybridLink activation first makes latent contents more interpretable, and the additional self-conditioned training sharpens the latent readability and semantic informativeness. We then take a closer look to examine individual test instances through detailed case studies in Appendix J . Specifically, methods with low faithfulness and specificity generally produce largely unreadable artifacts of the embedding geometry, whereas the complete HybridSFT yields clear and semantically coherent latent readouts. Overall, these analyses reveal that self-conditioned training is essential to HybridSFT for making the latent reasoning traces in HybridAgent fully transparent and directly interpretable.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步探究了每种方法在涵盖所有下游领域的 200 个问题中生成的潜在思想的语义。 图 8 显示了一个清晰的演进过程：首先，HybridLink 的激活使潜在内容更具可解释性；随后，额外的自条件训练进一步提升了潜在内容的可读性和语义信息量。 接着，我们通过附录 J 中的详细案例研究，对单个测试实例进行了更深入的考察。 具体而言，保真度和特异性较低的方法通常会生成几乎无法解读的嵌入几何结构产物，而完整的 HybridSFT 则能产生清晰且语义连贯的潜在输出。 总体而言，这些分析表明，自条件训练对于 HybridSFT 至关重要，它使得 HybridAgent 中的潜在推理痕迹完全透明且可以直接解释。

paragraphs.en: Training Dynamics of HybridRL. We analyze HybridAgent’s training behaviors to examine how it dynamically shifts and allocates reasoning effort across text/latent modes under HybridRL. In Figure 9 , as the training step increases, our 14B agent progressively allocates more generation to latent mode while simultaneously strengthening its tool-invocation capability. Through training, HybridAgent adaptively learns to better utilize its two modes, shifting more reasoning into faster latent thinking while selectively exposing only key steps for external auditing and tool use through the text interface.
paragraphs.zh: 混合强化学习的训练动态。 我们分析了混合智能体的训练行为，以研究它在混合强化学习框架下如何在文本/潜在模式之间动态转移和分配推理资源。 在图9中，随着训练步骤的增加，我们的14B智能体逐渐将更多生成任务分配到潜在模式，同时增强了其工具调用能力。 通过训练，混合智能体能够自适应地学习更有效地利用两种模式：将更多推理转移到更快的潜在思维中，同时仅通过文本接口选择性展示关键步骤，以供外部审计和工具使用。

paragraphs.en: Reward Shaping in HybridRL. We ablate each reward component in Eq. 11 using HybridAgent (8B), removing one term at a time under otherwise identical setups. In Table 4 , all three components provide complementary supervision. Excluding r correct r_{\text{correct}} causes the largest overall degradation, reducing performance by 6.4%-17.8%, while removing r format r_{\text{format}} consistently lowers performance by 4.7%-6.9%. The benefit of r tool r_{\text{tool}} is most pronounced on agentic benchmarks such as GAIA and WebWalker. Since the reward is granted only to trajectories that invoke both Python and search tools, removing r tool r_{\text{tool}} has a minor effect on MATH500, where Python alone is typically sufficient, but reduces GAIA and WebWalker by 11.2% and 3.5%. Overall, each reward component provides complementary supervision for answer correctness, format structure, and effective multi-tool use.

paragraphs.en: Does HybridAgent Causally Rely on its Latent Mode Thoughts? To examine whether latent thoughts are functionally used during hybrid reasoning, we intervene on the latent vectors generated by 8B and 14B HybridAgent on the MATH500 downstream task. We perturb their content, ordering, and reasoning duration through 4 different types of controlled interventions, including (i) noise perturbation , (ii) latent replacement , (iii) latent permutation , and (iv) latent computation restriction . Table 5 details the intervention setups and reports performance under each scenario.

paragraphs.en: As shown in the table, disrupting latent thoughts consistently degrades performance across both scales. Specifically, cross-problem and random-token replacement reduce accuracy by 44.9-47.0% and 49.4-51.3%, while disrupting their ordering or restricting each latent span to one step leads to 13.4-15.0% degradation. Notably, cross-problem replacement causes substantially greater degradation than even stronger Gaussian perturbations, suggesting that performance depends on the semantic content of latent thoughts rather than perturbation magnitude alone. These analysis results on causal interventions indicate that HybridAgent functionally relies on the semantics, ordering, and sufficient reasoning depth of its latent thoughts during hybrid reasoning.

paragraphs.en: HybridLink Design. We next validate the effectiveness of HybridLink and its residual connection by comparing our adopted 2-layer residual design against 4 alternative architectures: (i) direct hidden-state reuse (i.e., e t + 1 e_{t+1} = = h t h_{t} ) without learned alignment, (ii) 1-layer projection, (iii) 1-layer projection with residual connection, and (iv) 2-layer projection without residual connection. We end-to-end train each HybridLink variant with the 14B backbone under the same setup and evaluate across tasks.

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 6 , the full two-layer residual design of HybridLink yields consistent gains across all three downstream benchmarks, with the residual branch benefiting both one- and two-layer projection networks. Specifically, incorporating the residual connection contributes an average improvement of 4.3% across different layer depths. This observed trend aligns with our design motivation in Section 3.1 , where the residual connection preserves the semantics of input last-layer hidden states while the learned projection aligns these representations with the input embedding space. Together, these two components make HybridLink a more effective and stable interface for hybrid training and generation.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 6 所示，HybridLink 的完整双层残差设计在所有三个下游基准测试中均实现了稳定的性能提升，其中残差分支对单层和双层投影网络均有裨益。 具体而言，引入残差连接在不同层深度下平均带来了 4.3% 的性能提升。 这一观察到的趋势与第 3.1 节中我们的设计动机一致：残差连接保留了输入最后一层隐藏状态的语义信息，而学习到的投影则将这些表示与输入嵌入空间对齐。 这两个组件共同使 HybridLink 成为混合训练和生成过程中更高效、更稳定的接口。

paragraphs.en: Does HybridAgent Text-Mode Preserve Agentic Tool Use? In Figure 10 , we analyze agentic tool-calling capabilities by comparing HybridAgent with normal LLM agents trained on GRPO, examining whether hybrid reasoning preserves reliable external interactions through its text mode. Across 8B and 14B scales, HybridAgent achieves higher valid tool-call rates while matching the 99.7% execution success of valid calls, showing that hybrid reasoning preserves a reliable text-mode tool interface. More importantly, the gains extend beyond call validity, as HybridAgent improves final-answer accuracy by 2.2%-44.1% on questions where tools are invoked. The 4.5%-7.7% higher useful tool-call rate further indicates that HybridAgent not only invokes tools correctly, but also retrieves evidence that more directly contributes to solving the task. These findings suggest that HybridAgent preserves the reliable and effective agentic tool use of standard LLM agents through its text mode, while exposing fewer text tokens with interleaved latent reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 混合智能体文本模式能否保留智能体工具使用能力？ 在图 10 中，我们通过将混合智能体与基于 GRPO 训练的常规 LLM 智能体进行比较，分析了其智能体工具调用能力，旨在探究混合推理是否通过文本模式保留了可靠的外部交互能力。 在 8B 和 14B 模型规模上，混合智能体实现了更高的有效工具调用率，同时其有效调用的执行成功率达到了 99.7%，表明混合推理保留了可靠的文本模式工具接口。 更重要的是，这种提升不仅体现在调用有效性上：对于需要调用工具的问题，混合智能体将最终答案的准确率提升了 2.2% 至 44.1%。 其 4.5% 至 7.7% 的有效工具调用率提升进一步表明，混合智能体不仅能正确调用工具，还能获取更直接有助于任务解决的证据。 这些发现表明，混合智能体通过其文本模式保留了标准 LLM 智能体可靠且高效的智能体工具使用能力，同时因交错潜在线性推理而减少了文本标记的消耗。

paragraphs.en: Does HybridAgent Text-Mode Preserve External Auditability? A natural question of hybrid reasoning is whether shifting computation into latent mode might potentially compromise the external auditability provided by text. To examine this, we evaluate HybridAgent against matched text agents on MATH500 and AIME25/26, covering 560 problems under identical setups. For each question, an external observer sees only the exposed text steps, tool calls, and tool outputs, while latent spans remain hidden behind their boundary markers. We evaluate four complementary dimensions following commonly adopted evaluation protocols.
paragraphs.zh: HybridAgent 的文本模式能否保持外部可审计性？ 混合推理的一个自然疑问是：将计算切换到潜在模式，是否可能损害文本所提供的外部可审计性。 为检验这一点，我们在 MATH500 和 AIME25/26 上，以完全相同的设置，对 HybridAgent 与匹配的文本智能体进行了评估，共涵盖 560 道问题。 对于每道题，外部观察者只能看到暴露的文本步骤、工具调用和工具输出，而潜在部分的文本则隐藏在边界标记之后。 我们遵循通用的评估协议，从四个相互补充的维度进行评估。

sents.en: Does HybridAgent Text-Mode Preserve External Auditability?
sents.zh: HybridAgent 的文本模式能否保持外部可审计性？

sents.en: A natural question of hybrid reasoning is whether shifting computation into latent mode might potentially compromise the external auditability provided by text.
sents.zh: 混合推理的一个自然疑问是：将计算切换到潜在模式，是否可能损害文本所提供的外部可审计性。

sents.en: To examine this, we evaluate HybridAgent against matched text agents on MATH500 and AIME25/26, covering 560 problems under identical setups.
sents.zh: 为检验这一点，我们在 MATH500 和 AIME25/26 上，以完全相同的设置，对 HybridAgent 与匹配的文本智能体进行了评估，共涵盖 560 道问题。

sents.en: For each question, an external observer sees only the exposed text steps, tool calls, and tool outputs, while latent spans remain hidden behind their boundary markers.
sents.zh: 对于每道题，外部观察者只能看到暴露的文本步骤、工具调用和工具输出，而潜在部分的文本则隐藏在边界标记之后。

sents.en: We evaluate four complementary dimensions following commonly adopted evaluation protocols.
sents.zh: 我们遵循通用的评估协议，从四个相互补充的维度进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Monitoring : Measure whether a blind external monitor can predict rollout correctness from the input problem and visible trace generated by each agent, following Baker et al. (2025) . We report AUROC using GPT-4o-mini ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) as a weak monitor, which relies primarily on the visible trace rather than solving the problem independently, and GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as a strong monitor with more powerful task-solving capability.
paragraphs.zh: 监控：按照 Baker 等人（2025）的研究，衡量一个无知的外部监控器能否根据输入问题和每个智能体生成的可见轨迹预测展开过程的正确性。 我们使用 GPT-4o-mini（Hurst 等人，2024）作为弱监控器报告 AUROC 指标，它主要依赖可见轨迹而非独立解决问题；同时使用 GPT-5.6-Luna（OpenAI，2026）作为具有更强任务解决能力的强监控器。

sents.en: Monitoring : Measure whether a blind external monitor can predict rollout correctness from the input problem and visible trace generated by each agent, following Baker et al. (2025) .
sents.zh: 监控：按照 Baker 等人（2025）的研究，衡量一个无知的外部监控器能否根据输入问题和每个智能体生成的可见轨迹预测展开过程的正确性。

sents.en: We report AUROC using GPT-4o-mini ( Hurst et al., 2024 ) as a weak monitor, which relies primarily on the visible trace rather than solving the problem independently, and GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) as a strong monitor with more powerful task-solving capability.
sents.zh: 我们使用 GPT-4o-mini（Hurst 等人，2024）作为弱监控器报告 AUROC 指标，它主要依赖可见轨迹而非独立解决问题；同时使用 GPT-5.6-Luna（OpenAI，2026）作为具有更强任务解决能力的强监控器。

paragraphs.en: Debugging : Following first-error localization ( Zheng et al., 2025a ) , a judge model (GPT-5.6-Luna) is deployed to identify the first erroneous visible step from a failed rollout and produces a corrective hint, with the diagnosis verified against the reference ground-truth solution.
paragraphs.zh: 调试：在首次错误定位（Zheng 等人，2025a）之后，部署了一个评判模型（GPT-5.6-Luna），用于从一次失败的展开过程中识别出第一个可见的错误步骤，并生成纠正提示；该诊断结果会与参考的真实解进行验证。

paragraphs.en: Correction : Each failed problem is re-attempted using the corrective hint generated during debugging, and compared against a generic correctness-only feedback baseline ( Huang et al., 2024 ) that simply tells the agent its previous answer was incorrect and asks it to retry.
paragraphs.zh: 修正：每个失败的问题都会使用调试过程中生成的纠正提示进行重新尝试，并与一个仅关注正确性的通用反馈基线（Huang 等人，2024）进行比较；该基线仅告知智能体其之前的答案不正确，并要求其重试。

paragraphs.en: Rationale Sufficiency : Following sufficiency evaluation in DeYoung et al. (2020) , a weak reader (GPT-4o-mini) predicts the agent’s own answer from the exposed text steps alone after removing the final answer, measuring whether the visible trace retains sufficient decision-relevant information.
paragraphs.zh: 推理充分性：遵循 DeYoung 等人（2020）中的充分性评估方法。 一个较弱的模型（GPT-4o-mini）仅根据暴露的文本步骤预测智能体自身的答案，同时移除最终答案，以此衡量可见的推理痕迹是否保留了足够的与决策相关的信息。

sents.en: Rationale Sufficiency : Following sufficiency evaluation in DeYoung et al.
sents.zh: 推理充分性：遵循 DeYoung 等人（2020）中的充分性评估方法。

sents.en: (2020) , a weak reader (GPT-4o-mini) predicts the agent’s own answer from the exposed text steps alone after removing the final answer, measuring whether the visible trace retains sufficient decision-relevant information.
sents.zh: 一个较弱的模型（GPT-4o-mini）仅根据暴露的文本步骤预测智能体自身的答案，同时移除最终答案，以此衡量可见的推理痕迹是否保留了足够的与决策相关的信息。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 7 , HybridAgent exposes 43%-49% fewer text-mode tokens while performing 170-183 reasoning steps in latent mode, yet the visible trace contains 26%-28% more key reasoning steps per 100 tokens. This reduction preserves external monitorability, with AUROC remaining within 0.022 of matched text agents across both weak and strong monitors. The exposed text also remains debuggable, localizing the first error in 98%-99% of failed rollouts and yielding reference-consistent diagnoses in 97%-98% of cases with below 1% answer leakage. Moreover, text-derived corrective hints produce significant fix-rate gains of 5.4 and 9.1 points at 14B and 8B, while rationale sufficiency remains comparable to or higher than text agents. As shown by the analyses above, HybridAgent uses its text mode to maintain a compact yet informative textual interface for external monitoring, debugging, and correction. This provides an important safeguard for agent generation, facilitating human auditing and intervention while preserving efficient internal reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 7 所示，HybridAgent 在潜模式中进行 170-183 步推理的同时，暴露的文本模式标记减少了 43%-49%，但其可见轨迹中每 100 个标记包含的关键推理步骤却增加了 26%-28%。 这种减少并未影响外部可监控性：在弱监控和强监控两种情况下，AUROC 与匹配的文本智能体之间的差异均未超过 0.022。 暴露的文本内容也保持了可调试性：在 98%-99% 的失败运行中能够定位首个错误，并且在答案泄露低于 1% 的情况下，有 97%-98% 的案例能生成与参考结果一致的诊断。 此外，源自文本的纠正提示带来了显著的修复率提升：在 14B 和 8B 模型上分别提升了 5.4 和 9.1 个百分点，同时其推理充分性仍与文本智能体相当或更高。 如上分析所示，HybridAgent 利用其文本模式，为外部监控、调试和纠正保留了一个紧凑且信息丰富的文本接口。 这为智能体生成提供了重要的保障机制，既促进了人类审计与干预，又保持了高效的内部推理能力。

sents.zh: 这种减少并未影响外部可监控性：在弱监控和强监控两种情况下，AUROC 与匹配的文本智能体之间的差异均未超过 0.022。

sents.en: The exposed text also remains debuggable, localizing the first error in 98%-99% of failed rollouts and yielding reference-consistent diagnoses in 97%-98% of cases with below 1% answer leakage.
sents.zh: 暴露的文本内容也保持了可调试性：在 98%-99% 的失败运行中能够定位首个错误，并且在答案泄露低于 1% 的情况下，有 97%-98% 的案例能生成与参考结果一致的诊断。

sents.en: Moreover, text-derived corrective hints produce significant fix-rate gains of 5.4 and 9.1 points at 14B and 8B, while rationale sufficiency remains comparable to or higher than text agents.
sents.zh: 此外，源自文本的纠正提示带来了显著的修复率提升：在 14B 和 8B 模型上分别提升了 5.4 和 9.1 个百分点，同时其推理充分性仍与文本智能体相当或更高。

sents.en: As shown by the analyses above, HybridAgent uses its text mode to maintain a compact yet informative textual interface for external monitoring, debugging, and correction.
sents.zh: 如上分析所示，HybridAgent 利用其文本模式，为外部监控、调试和纠正保留了一个紧凑且信息丰富的文本接口。

sents.en: This provides an important safeguard for agent generation, facilitating human auditing and intervention while preserving efficient internal reasoning.
sents.zh: 这为智能体生成提供了重要的保障机制，既促进了人类审计与干预，又保持了高效的内部推理能力。

paragraphs.en: Latent Reasoning Beyond Text. Recent works have explored applying intermediate reasoning beyond discrete language tokens into continuous hidden spaces ( Hao et al., 2024 ; Zhu et al., 2025a ; Yu et al., 2026 ) , allowing models to perform internal computation without explicitly verbalizing every reasoning step ( Geiping et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025b ) . Existing approaches broadly realize this idea by inputting last-layer hidden states ( Saunshi et al., 2025 ; Tack et al., 2026 ) , compressing textual chains of thought into latent representations ( Cheng and Van Durme, 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) , or directly optimizing continuous reasoning trajectories ( Tan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . These methods improve reasoning efficiency and depth but make direct inspection and external interaction difficult ( Korbak et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . HybridAgent builds on this direction by integrating directly inspectable latent reasoning as a native built-in mode within the agentic generation process, while preserving direct text-based auditing and tool interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 超越文本的潜在推理。 近期研究探索了将中间推理从离散的文本词元扩展到连续隐藏空间（Hao 等，2024；Zhu 等，2025a；Yu 等，2026），使模型无需明确表述每一步推理即可进行内部计算（Geiping 等，2026；Shen 等，2026；Zhu 等，2025b）。 现有方法主要通过输入最后一层的隐藏状态（Saunshi 等，2025；Tack 等，2026）、将文本思维链压缩为潜在表示（Cheng 和 Van Durme，2024；Zhang 等，2026a），或直接优化连续推理轨迹（Tan 等，2026；Chen 等，2024）来实现这一理念。 这些方法提升了推理效率和深度，但使得直接检查和外部交互变得困难（Korbak 等，2025；Chen 等，2026）。 HybridAgent 在这一方向上进一步创新，它将可直接检查的潜在推理整合为智能体生成过程中的原生内置模式，同时保留了基于文本的直接审计和工具交互能力。

paragraphs.en: Agentic Reasoning and Tool Use. Frontier LLM agents ( Team, 2026 ; GLM-5-Team and others, 2026 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) extend reasoning beyond static generation by interacting with external environments through tools ( Shen, 2024 ; Qu et al., 2025 ) , such as search engines ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2025b ) , code interpreters ( Feng et al., 2026 ; Bianchi et al., 2026 ) , and APIs ( Qin et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2025 ) . A growing line of work further improves these capabilities through post-training over multi-turn tool-use trajectories ( Dong et al., 2025a ; Qian et al., 2025 ) , enabling agents to plan, act, observe, and revise their reasoning ( Su et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025c ) . Despite this progress, existing agentic frameworks remain text-centric for both model-side reasoning and environment-side interaction, incurring large generation overhead from verbalizing every intermediate step ( Cuadron et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025a ) . HybridAgent decouples these roles by interleaving continuous thoughts for internal reasoning and retaining text only where explicit interaction and monitoring are required.

paragraphs.en: Implications for Frontier Agent Safety and Secure Deployment. Frontier labs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) provide API-based access to reasoning models while hiding the chain-of-thought from customers to protect intellectual property and limit information leakage, yet Panfilov et al. (2026) show that the encrypted traces returned to clients can be replayed into a sibling model and transcribed verbatim. HybridAgent places proprietary reasoning on a different footing. Latent thoughts exist only as backbone hidden states that are readable solely through the provider-owned HybridLink (Section 3 ), so no text exists to leak. The same property aids monitoring. Because the latent trace is held by the provider rather than the client, providers can assess the safety of reasoning and actions over the full readout, including the portion users never see, while the agent benefits from faster inner thinking. Text mode is then reserved for what users legitimately need, such as tool calls, key decisions, and the final answer, preserving an auditable trace without exposing the full reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 对前沿智能体安全与可靠部署的影响。 前沿实验室（例如 OpenAI、Anthropic）通过 API 提供推理模型的访问权限，同时向客户隐藏思维链，以保护知识产权并限制信息泄露，但 Panfilov 等人 （2026）的研究表明，返回客户端的加密痕迹可以被重放到关联模型中，并被逐字转录。 HybridAgent 将专有推理置于不同的基础之上。 潜在思维仅以骨干隐藏状态的形式存在，这些状态只能通过提供商所有的 HybridLink（第 3 节）读取，因此不存在可能泄露的文本。 这一特性也有助于监控。 由于潜在痕迹由提供商而非客户端持有，提供商可以在完整的输出记录上评估推理和行动的安全性，包括用户从未看到的部分，而智能体则能受益于更快的内部思考过程。 文本模式因此被保留用于用户确实需要的内容，例如工具调用、关键决策和最终答案，从而在暴露完整推理过程的同时，保留可审计的痕迹。

paragraphs.en: Future Directions on Hybrid Agent Harness and Efficient Post-Training. Future work can build a new type of agent harness around HybridAgent, where latent working memory is a first-class component. Context management can then operate on KV entries directly, workflows can schedule steps by mode, keeping tool calls and human-facing checkpoints in text while routine computation stays latent, and one agent’s hybrid trajectory can serve as its message to another. Hybrid generation can also make post-training more efficient. Because latent thoughts remain auditable during rollout, an external critic can assign step-level credit to latent spans, branch promising trajectories, or terminate ones whose latent reasoning has already gone wrong, before any text or tool call is produced.
paragraphs.zh: 混合智能体框架与高效后训练的未来方向。 未来的工作可以围绕 HybridAgent 构建一种新型的智能体框架，其中潜在工作记忆将成为一个一级组件。 这样，上下文管理就可以直接操作 KV 条目，工作流程可以根据模式安排步骤，将工具调用和面向人类的检查点保留在文本中，同时让常规计算保持潜在状态，并且一个智能体的混合轨迹可以作为其向另一个智能体传递的信息。 混合生成也可以使后训练更加高效。 因为在推理过程中潜在思维仍然可以被审查，外部批评者可以在任何文本或工具调用被生成之前，为潜在片段分配步骤级信用、分支有前景的轨迹，或者终止那些潜在推理已经出错的轨迹。

paragraphs.en: We introduce HybridAgent, a unified hybrid reasoning framework that combines efficient latent reasoning with text-based inspection and tool interaction. HybridAgent enables multi-turn hybrid generation through both architectural designs and dedicated post-training algorithms on SFT and RL stages. Across 11 benchmarks and 3 model scales, HybridAgent achieves strong performance against advanced LLM agents and agentic frameworks spanning text-based and latent reasoning methods, while substantially reducing inference time, token usage, and computational cost. Overall, HybridAgent provides a scalable and efficient framework for next-generation agents that can reason beyond human language while retaining agentic interaction in environments and external inspectability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HybridAgent，这是一个统一的混合推理框架，将高效的潜在推理与基于文本的检查和工具交互相结合。 HybridAgent 通过架构设计以及在 SFT 和 RL 阶段采用的专用后训练算法，实现了多轮混合生成。 在 11 项基准测试和 3 种模型规模中，HybridAgent 相较于先进的 LLM 智能体和涵盖基于文本与潜在推理方法的智能体框架，展现出强劲的性能，同时显著减少了推理时间、令牌使用量和计算成本。 总体而言，HybridAgent 为下一代智能体提供了一个可扩展且高效的框架，使其能够在超越人类语言范畴进行推理的同时，保持与环境交互的能力以及外部可检查性。

paragraphs.en: We expand on the method description of HybridSFT (Section 4.1 ), providing additional design justifications and implementation details for the overall training scheme.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对 HybridSFT（第 4.1 节）的方法描述进行了扩展，为整体训练方案提供了额外的设计依据和实现细节。

paragraphs.en: The format and HybridLink activation provide a well-aligned initialization, but both are teacher-forced (Figure 11 , left). At every latent position, the backbone consumes the ground-truth embedding Emb ⁡ ( y ) \mathrm{Emb}(y) , and HybridLink is trained only to match its output ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) to that target; the prediction itself is never fed back as an input. At inference, the agent instead runs free (Figure 11 , right). Once it enters latent mode, every subsequent input is its own ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) , which neither the backbone nor HybridLink has been conditioned on. This train-inference mismatch is akin to exposure bias ( Ranzato et al., 2015 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) , a standard issue in autoregressive sequence models that are trained on ground-truth prefixes but consume their own predictions at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 这种格式和 HybridLink 激活机制提供了高度对齐的初始化，但两者都是教师强制的（图 11，左）。 在每个潜在位置，主干网络都会消耗真实嵌入 Emb⁡(y) \mathrm{Emb}(y)，而 HybridLink 仅被训练使其输出 ℛ⁡(h) \mathcal{R}(h) 与该目标匹配；预测结果本身绝不会作为输入反馈回去。 在推理阶段，智能体则改为自由运行（图 11，右）。 一旦进入潜在模式，每个后续输入都是其自身的 ℛ⁡(h) \mathcal{R}(h)，而主干网络和 HybridLink 均未以此为基础进行条件训练。 这种训练与推理之间的不匹配类似于暴露偏差（Ranzato 等人，2015；Bengio 等人，2015），这是自回归序列模型中的一个典型问题：这些模型在训练时使用的是真实前缀，但在推理时却使用自身的预测结果。

sents.en: This train-inference mismatch is akin to exposure bias ( Ranzato et al., 2015 ; Bengio et al., 2015 ) , a standard issue in autoregressive sequence models that are trained on ground-truth prefixes but consume their own predictions at inference.
sents.zh: 这种训练与推理之间的不匹配类似于暴露偏差（Ranzato 等人，2015；Bengio 等人，2015），这是自回归序列模型中的一个典型问题：这些模型在训练时使用的是真实前缀，但在推理时却使用自身的预测结果。

paragraphs.en: It is worth noting that exposure bias is present in both text and latent modes, since both feed the model’s own outputs back as inputs. In text mode (as in standard LLM SFT), each fed-back input is sampled and re-embedded, and thus always corresponds to a token in the discrete vocabulary. A prediction error, where the sampled token differs from the ground-truth target, only changes which token is fed back; the input representation itself never leaves the set seen in training, so errors cannot compound in the input space. Latent mode, in contrast, has no such projection. ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) is continuous and fed back unquantized, so even a small deviation from the target embedding becomes an input the backbone has never seen in training. This deviation propagates to the next hidden state and hence the next latent input, compounding over the tens to hundreds of steps in a latent span and gradually eroding the semantic coherence of the latent trace.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，文本模式和潜在模式中都存在暴露偏差，因为两者都将模型自身的输出作为输入反馈给模型。 在文本模式下（如标准的 LLM SFT），每个反馈的输入都会被采样并重新嵌入，因此始终对应于离散词汇表中的一个词元。 预测误差（即采样词元与真实目标词元不同）只会改变反馈的词元；输入表示本身绝不会超出训练时见过的集合，因此错误无法在输入空间中累积。 相比之下，潜在模式没有这种投影。ℛ ⁡ ( h ) \mathcal{R}(h) 是连续的且未经量化地反馈，因此即使与目标嵌入存在微小偏差，也会成为主干网络在训练中从未见过的输入。 这种偏差会传播到下一个隐藏状态，进而影响下一个潜在输入，并在潜在跨度中数十至数百个步骤内不断累积，逐渐削弱潜在轨迹的语义连贯性。

sents.en: This deviation propagates to the next hidden state and hence the next latent input, compounding over the tens to hundreds of steps in a latent span and gradually eroding the semantic coherence of the latent trace.

paragraphs.en: Self-conditioned HybridSFT closes this gap by training both components on the model’s own generated latent inputs. As in Figure 4 , the teacher-forced first pass applies HybridLink to the last-layer hidden state at each latent position, yielding the model’s own prediction of the next latent input. The second pass then replaces the ground-truth latent embeddings with these predictions and trains the backbone and HybridLink jointly, so both parts learn under the same latent inputs they encounter at inference.
paragraphs.zh: Self-conditioned HybridSFT 通过在模型自身生成的潜在输入上训练两个组件，从而弥合了这一差距。 如图 4 所示，教师强制的第一遍处理将 HybridLink 应用于每个潜在位置处最后一层的隐藏状态，从而得到模型对下一个潜在输入的自身预测。 第二遍处理随后用这些预测结果替换真实潜在嵌入，并联合训练主干网络和 HybridLink，这样两个部分都能在推理时遇到的相同潜在输入下进行学习。

sents.zh: Self-conditioned HybridSFT 通过在模型自身生成的潜在输入上训练两个组件，从而弥合了这一差距。

sents.zh: 第二遍处理随后用这些预测结果替换真实潜在嵌入，并联合训练主干网络和 HybridLink，这样两个部分都能在推理时遇到的相同潜在输入下进行学习。

paragraphs.en: Under this training scheme, the backbone learns to read, and HybridLink learns to produce, latent inputs under the same conditions they encounter at inference. Thus, HybridAgent is trained as an integrated whole rather than two separately activated components.
paragraphs.zh: 在这种训练方案中，主干网络学习读取潜在输入，而 HybridLink 则学习在推理时遇到的相同条件下生成这些潜在输入。 因此，HybridAgent 作为一个集成整体进行训练，而不是两个分别激活的组件。

paragraphs.en: As stated in Section 3 , HybridAgent transitions between modes through two special tokens, the entry anchor <latent> and the exit anchor </latent> . Within a latent span, these anchors are the only positions supervised by ℒ Backbone \mathcal{L}_{\text{Backbone}} , while every other latent position is supervised by ℒ HybridLink \mathcal{L}_{\text{HybridLink }} alone. The two transitions are not symmetric, however. Entering latent mode is decided in text mode, where the backbone samples the next token from the vocabulary as usual, whereas exiting must be decided from a continuous latent state through the readout in Eq. 5 . HybridSFT therefore treats the entry anchor as an ordinary token and gives the exit anchor dedicated supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 如第 3 节所述，HybridAgent 通过两个特殊标记在模式间切换：进入锚点 <latent> 和退出锚点 </latent>。 在一个潜在区间内，这些锚点是唯一由 ℒ Backbone \mathcal{L}_{\text{Backbone}} 监督的位置，而其他所有潜在位置仅由 ℒ HybridLink \mathcal{L}_{\text{HybridLink}} 单独监督。 然而，这两种模式切换并非对称的。 进入潜在模式的决定在文本模式下做出，此时主干模型像往常一样从词汇表中采样下一个标记；而退出模式则必须通过公式 5 中的读出机制，基于连续的潜在状态来决定。 因此，HybridSFT 将进入锚点视为一个普通标记，并对退出锚点进行专门的监督。

The anchor position then serves as the first latent step, with its last-layer hidden state passed through HybridLink to produce the next latent input, so the span begins without any additional mechanism.

paragraphs.en: Exit as a Latent-Mode Decision. Exiting takes place in latent mode, where no token is sampled. paragraphs.en: Adaptive Reasoning on Text and Latent Space. Beyond fixed-length chains of thought, recent work lets LLMs adapt how long and in which medium they reason ( Bigverdi et al., 2024 ; Lv et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) , for example by learning when to stop latent reasoning or deciding whether explicit deliberation is needed ( Ning et al., 2025 ) . Several methods interleave latent reasoning with text decoding ( Yue et al., 2025 ) , using confidence or entropy signals ( Xu et al., 2026 ) to shift into continuous representations at uncertain steps and explore alternative reasoning paths ( Fu and Luo, 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ) . However, existing methods largely operate within one reasoning pass or switch modes only at single-turn granularity, and their latent states remain largely opaque to inspect directly. Orthogonal to this line, HybridAgent uses latent mode for efficient deeper reasoning, carries latent context across multiple turns through continuous working memory, keeps latent thoughts directly readable, and preserves the agentic tool-use abilities for long-horizon tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 文本与潜在空间中的自适应推理。 除了固定长度的思维链，近期的研究让大型语言模型能够自适应其推理的长度和媒介（Bigverdi 等，2024；Lv 等，2026；Yang 等，2026；Ye 等，2026），例如通过学习何时停止潜在推理，或决定是否需要显式推理（Ning 等，2025）。 多种方法将潜在推理与文本解码交替进行（Yue 等，2025），利用置信度或熵信号（Xu 等，2026）在不确定步骤中切换到连续表示，并探索替代的推理路径（Fu 和 Luo，2026；Shi 等，2026）。 然而，现有方法大多仅在一次推理过程中运行，或在单个回合的粒度上切换模式，且其潜在状态在很大程度上仍不透明，无法直接检查。 与此研究路线正交的是，HybridAgent 使用潜在模式进行高效的深度推理，通过连续工作记忆在多个回合中携带潜在上下文，使潜在思维可直接读取，并保留智能体在长期任务中的工具使用能力。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid Communication among Agents. A recent line of work in multi-agent systems (MAS) parallel to HybridAgent studies hybrid-protocol communication , in which each inter-agent message combines two media. A latent channel carries dense intermediate signals such as hidden states or KV entries, while a text channel carries concise commitments that remain inspectable. Early instances augment each natural-language message with the sender’s internal state trajectory ( Tang et al., 2025 ) , and later work formalizes the dual-channel design by routing elaborate reasoning through latent vectors while keeping answers and decisions in text ( Mou et al., 2026 ; Dai et al., 2026 ) . More recent works take the same view from the deployment side, pairing every latent payload with a visible text commitment wherever oversight is required ( Liu, 2026 ) and evaluating the security of latent transfer alongside visible text ( Brito and Baquero, 2026 ) . Complementary to these inter-agent protocols in the MAS setting, HybridAgent decides the medium at the level of each generation step within a single agent, switching between latent reasoning and text-based tool interaction over multi-turn trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体间的混合通信。 多智能体系统（MAS）领域近期的一项研究，与 HybridAgent 并行推进，探讨了混合协议通信，其中每条智能体间消息都结合了两种媒介。 一个潜在通道承载密集的中间信号，例如隐藏状态或 KV 条目，而文本通道则承载可被检查的简洁承诺。 早期的研究在每条自然语言消息中附加了发送方的内部状态轨迹（Tang et al., 2025），后续研究则通过让复杂的推理过程经由潜在向量传递，同时将答案和决策保留在文本中，正式确立了双通道设计（Mou et al., 2026；Dai et al., 2026）。 更近期的研究从部署角度采取了相同观点：在需要监督的每个环节，都将潜在的负载与可见的文本承诺配对（Liu, 2026），并评估潜在传输与可见文本的安全性（Brito and Baquero, 2026）。 作为 MAS 环境中这些智能体间协议的补充，HybridAgent 在单个智能体的每次生成步骤层面决定使用何种媒介，在多轮交互过程中在潜在推理和基于文本的工具交互之间切换。

paragraphs.en: KV-Cache Reuse. Reusing key–value (KV) entries across generation steps is standard practice for efficient serving ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) , and recent work extends it across requests, caching shared prefixes and prompt modules ( Gim et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ; Juravsky et al., 2024 ) and composing independently encoded caches so that repeated context need not be prefilled again ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ) . These methods treat the KV cache as an optimization over a context that could in principle be re-encoded from text. HybridAgent likewise builds on the backbone’s own KV entries, using them as a unified working memory that stores and propagates both latent and text information across multi-turn hybrid generation.
paragraphs.zh: KV-Cache 重用。 在生成步骤中重复使用键值（KV）条目是高效服务中的标准做法（Kwon 等，2023；Zheng 等，2024），而近期的研究则将其扩展到跨请求的范畴，通过缓存共享前缀和提示模块（Gim 等，2024；Ye 等，2024；Juravsky 等，2024），以及组合独立编码的缓存，使得重复的上下文无需再次预填充（Yang 等，2025b；Ma 等，2025；Hu 等，2025）。 这些方法将 KV 缓存视为对一种原则上可以从文本重新编码的上下文的优化。 HybridAgent 同样基于骨干模型自身的 KV 条目，将其用作统一的短期记忆，用于在多轮混合生成过程中存储和传递潜在信息与文本信息。

paragraphs.en: We curate the hybrid training data by converting existing multi-turn agentic demonstrations ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2025b ) into 54k hybrid trajectories for text and latent supervision. Specifically, an automatic annotation pipeline is designed to assign each source CoT step to either text or latent mode, based on complementary signals from external LLM judges and the target model’s entropy-based confidence, with no human labeling needed. Accordingly, high-confidence reasoning steps that the model can handle reliably are assigned as latent targets, while audit-critical reasoning and tool-interaction steps are retained as text targets. We describe the detailed curation pipeline below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将现有的多轮智能体演示（Yu et al., 2025；Dong et al., 2025b）转换为 5.4 万个混合轨迹，来构建用于文本和潜在监督的混合训练数据。 具体来说，我们设计了一条自动标注流程：基于外部 LLM 判定的互补信号以及目标模型基于熵值的置信度，将每个源 CoT 步骤分配给文本模式或潜在模式，整个过程无需人工标注。 因此，模型能够可靠处理的高置信度推理步骤被指定为潜在目标，而审计关键性推理和工具交互步骤则保留为文本目标。 我们在下文详细描述了这一构建流程。

sents.en: We curate the hybrid training data by converting existing multi-turn agentic demonstrations ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Dong et al., 2025b ) into 54k hybrid trajectories for text and latent supervision.
sents.zh: 我们通过将现有的多轮智能体演示（Yu et al., 2025；Dong et al., 2025b）转换为 5.4 万个混合轨迹，来构建用于文本和潜在监督的混合训练数据。

sents.en: Specifically, an automatic annotation pipeline is designed to assign each source CoT step to either text or latent mode, based on complementary signals from external LLM judges and the target model’s entropy-based confidence, with no human labeling needed.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们设计了一条自动标注流程：基于外部 LLM 判定的互补信号以及目标模型基于熵值的置信度，将每个源 CoT 步骤分配给文本模式或潜在模式，整个过程无需人工标注。

sents.en: Accordingly, high-confidence reasoning steps that the model can handle reliably are assigned as latent targets, while audit-critical reasoning and tool-interaction steps are retained as text targets.
sents.zh: 因此，模型能够可靠处理的高置信度推理步骤被指定为潜在目标，而审计关键性推理和工具交互步骤则保留为文本目标。

sents.en: We describe the detailed curation pipeline below.
sents.zh: 我们在下文详细描述了这一构建流程。

paragraphs.en: Step Segmentation. We first split each source trajectory into atomic reasoning steps using a deterministic procedure, recording their exact character offsets. These offsets allow subsequent annotations to identify and group steps while preserving the original content and ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤分割。 我们首先通过一个确定性程序将每个源轨迹拆分为原子推理步骤，并记录其精确的字符偏移量。 这些偏移量使得后续标注能够识别和分组各个步骤，同时保留原始内容和顺序。

sents.en: Step Segmentation.
sents.zh: 步骤分割。

sents.en: We first split each source trajectory into atomic reasoning steps using a deterministic procedure, recording their exact character offsets.
sents.zh: 我们首先通过一个确定性程序将每个源轨迹拆分为原子推理步骤，并记录其精确的字符偏移量。

sents.en: These offsets allow subsequent annotations to identify and group steps while preserving the original content and ordering.
sents.zh: 这些偏移量使得后续标注能够识别和分组各个步骤，同时保留原始内容和顺序。

paragraphs.en: Mode Assignment. We then leverage external LLM experts (GPT-6.1-Sol/GPT-5.6-Luna) to assign each reasoning step to text or latent mode, with tool interactions and key steps needed for external inspection retained in text mode (See Prompts in Appendix I ). Meanwhile, we complement the external selection with the target model’s prediction entropy. We teacher-force the original textual trajectory through a frozen base model and compute the mean token-level entropy for each step s s :
paragraphs.zh: 模式分配。 接着，我们利用外部的 LLM 专家（GPT-6.1-Sol/GPT-5.6-Luna）为每个推理步骤分配文本模式或潜在模式，同时将工具交互和需要外部检查的关键步骤保留在文本模式中（参见附录 I 中的提示）。 与此同时，我们还用目标模型的预测熵来补充外部选择。 我们通过一个冻结的基础模型对原始的文本轨迹进行教师强制，并计算每个步骤 s 的平均词元级熵：

sents.en: Mode Assignment.
sents.zh: 模式分配。

sents.en: We then leverage external LLM experts (GPT-6.1-Sol/GPT-5.6-Luna) to assign each reasoning step to text or latent mode, with tool interactions and key steps needed for external inspection retained in text mode (See Prompts in Appendix I ).
sents.zh: 接着，我们利用外部的 LLM 专家（GPT-6.1-Sol/GPT-5.6-Luna）为每个推理步骤分配文本模式或潜在模式，同时将工具交互和需要外部检查的关键步骤保留在文本模式中（参见附录 I 中的提示）。

sents.en: We teacher-force the original textual trajectory through a frozen base model and compute the mean token-level entropy for each step s s :

paragraphs.en: where f θ ​ ( v ∣ x , τ < t ) f_{\theta}(v\mid x,\tau_{<t}) denotes the frozen base model’s next-token probability after the vocabulary projection and softmax. Here, x x is the input question, τ < t \tau_{<t} contains preceding reasoning and tool observations, ℐ s \mathcal{I}_{s} indexes the tokens in step s s , and 𝒱 \mathcal{V} is the vocabulary. Low-entropy steps become latent candidates, while high-entropy steps remain in text mode. Initial mode assignments combining the two complementary signals are then refined through the visibility audit below.

paragraphs.en: Visibility Audit. An independent LLM critic next examines the visible version of each annotated trajectory, with candidate latent spans hidden. The critic assesses whether the remaining text and tool interactions provide sufficient information to follow the agent’s decisions. When decision-critical information is missing, the corresponding source steps are restored to text mode. This audit helps preserve the key information needed for external debugging and inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 可见性审计。 接下来，一个独立的 LLM 评论员会检查每个已标注轨迹的可见版本，同时隐藏候选潜在片段。 该评论员会评估剩余文本和工具交互是否提供了足够的信息，以便理解智能体的决策过程。 当缺失对决策至关重要的信息时，相应的源步骤将被恢复为文本模式。 这项审计有助于保留外部调试和检查所需的关键信息。

sents.en: Visibility Audit.
sents.zh: 可见性审计。

sents.en: This audit helps preserve the key information needed for external debugging and inspection.
sents.zh: 这项审计有助于保留外部调试和检查所需的关键信息。

paragraphs.en: Hybrid Trajectory Construction. We merge adjacent latent-assigned steps into continuous spans and programmatically insert the special anchors <latent> and </latent> . Tool calls and observations remain in text form. Finally, we verify that removing the inserted anchors recovers the original trajectory byte for byte. This consistency check ensures that the pipeline annotates reasoning modes without rewriting or altering the source demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 混合轨迹构建。 我们将相邻的潜在分配步骤合并为连续区间，并程序化地插入特殊锚点 <latent> 和 </latent>。 工具调用和观察结果保持文本形式。 最后，我们验证移除所插入的锚点后能否逐字节恢复原始轨迹。 这种一致性检查确保了流程能够在不重写或修改源演示的情况下标注推理模式。

sents.en: Hybrid Trajectory Construction.
sents.zh: 混合轨迹构建。

sents.en: We merge adjacent latent-assigned steps into continuous spans and programmatically insert the special anchors <latent> and </latent> .
sents.zh: 我们将相邻的潜在分配步骤合并为连续区间，并程序化地插入特殊锚点 <latent> 和 </latent>。

paragraphs.en: To examine the effectiveness of hybrid reasoning at smaller model scales, we evaluate HybridAgent and corresponding text-based and latent baselines on Qwen3-4B-Base. As shown in Table 8 , HybridSFT outperforms both latent baselines across all four benchmarks and improves over standard text SFT on AIME25 and AIME26. HybridRL further improves performance across all four benchmarks, achieving the best results and exceeding ARPO by an average of 2.0 percentage points. Together with 8B and 14B comparisons in Table 1 and 2 , these results show that the benefits of hybrid reasoning can extend to different model scales of HybridAgent across downstream reasoning tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 为了探究混合推理在较小模型规模下的有效性，我们在 Qwen3-4B-Base 上评估了 HybridAgent 以及相应的文本基线和潜在基线。 如表 8 所示，HybridSFT 在所有四个基准测试中均优于两种潜在基线，并且在 AIME25 和 AIME26 上的表现也优于标准的文本 SFT。 HybridRL 进一步提升了所有四个基准测试中的性能，取得了最佳结果，并且平均比 ARPO 高出 2.0 个百分点。 结合表 1 和表 2 中 8B 与 14B 的对比结果，这些发现表明混合推理的优势可以延伸至 HybridAgent 在不同模型规模下的各类下游推理任务中。

paragraphs.en: Cost Analyses on HybridAgent. To examine whether the efficiency of hybrid generation translates into lower computational cost, we compare HybridAgent with matched text agents across 4B, 8B, and 14B backbones. We estimate decoding compute by charging every text or latent step a full backbone forward pass, together with the cost of vocabulary projection or the HybridLink adapter, respectively. Step counts are averaged over matched evaluations with the same questions, generation budgets, and tool-call limits. We further estimate monetary costs assuming $2.50 per H100-hour and 10% utilization of peak BF16 throughput. These estimates cover generation compute and exclude prompt prefill, context-dependent attention, and external tool execution. As shown in Table 9 , HybridAgent consistently reduces estimated decoding compute across all three model scales, from 51.2–66.9 TFLOP to 13.9–25.1 TFLOP per question, corresponding to reductions of 62.5%–72.9%. Under the stated pricing and utilization assumptions, the estimated cost of answering one million questions decreases from $359 to $98 at 4B, from $439 to $121 at 8B, and from $470 to $176 at 14B, yielding cost reduction factors of 3.7 × 3.7\times , 3.6 × 3.6\times , and 2.7 × 2.7\times , respectively. Together with the shorter generation trajectories in Figure 6 , these results demonstrate that hybrid reasoning reduces overall decoding compute while explicitly accounting for the backbone computation incurred by latent steps.
paragraphs.zh: HybridAgent 的成本分析。 为了检验混合生成效率是否确实能转化为更低的计算成本，我们将 HybridAgent 与在 4B、8B 和 14B 基础模型上运行的匹配文本智能体进行了比较。 我们通过为每个文本或潜在步骤分配一次完整的基础模型前向传播来计算解码计算量，并分别计入词汇表投影或 HybridLink 适配器的成本。 步骤数量是在使用相同问题、生成预算和工具调用限制的匹配评估中取平均值得出的。 我们还基于每 H100 小时 2.50 美元以及 BF16 峰值吞吐量 10% 的利用率，估算了货币成本。 这些估算涵盖了生成计算量，但不包括提示预填充、上下文相关注意力和外部工具执行。 如表 9 所示，HybridAgent 在所有三种模型规模下均持续降低了估算的解码计算量：每问题从 51.2–66.9 TFLOP 降至 13.9–25.1 TFLOP，降幅分别为 62.5%–72.9%。 在上述定价和利用率假设下，回答一百万个问题所需的估算成本在 4B 模型中从 359 美元降至 98 美元，在 8B 模型中从 439 美元降至 121 美元，在 14B 模型中从 470 美元降至 176 美元，成本降低倍数分别为 3.7 × 3.7\times、3.6 × 3.6\times 和 2.7 × 2.7\times。 结合图 6 中更短的生成轨迹，这些结果表明，混合推理在明确计入潜在步骤所引发的基础模型计算量的同时，也降低了整体的解码计算量。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate HybridAgent on 11 benchmarks spanning mathematical, knowledge-intensive, and agentic reasoning. Together, these benchmarks assess complementary capabilities in multi-step problem solving, specialized knowledge application, evidence integration, and tool-assisted information seeking. We follow the setup of Dong et al. (2025b) and describe each benchmark in detail below.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在涵盖数学推理、知识密集型推理和智能体推理的 11 个基准测试上对 HybridAgent 进行了评估。这些基准测试共同评估了多步骤问题解决、专业知识应用、证据整合以及工具辅助信息检索等方面的互补能力。我们遵循 Dong 等人（2025b）的实验设置，并在下文对每个基准测试进行了详细描述。

paragraphs.en: AIME 25 ( math-ai, 2025 ) : AIME 25 comprises 30 problems from the 2025 American Invitational Mathematics Examination, covering algebra, geometry, number theory, and combinatorics. Its integer-answer problems evaluate competition-level mathematical reasoning, requiring models to combine mathematical insights with precise multi-step calculations.
paragraphs.zh: AIME 25 (math-ai, 2025)：AIME 25 包含 2025 年美国邀请数学竞赛中的 30 道题目，涵盖代数、几何、数论和组合数学。 其整数答案类题目旨在评估竞赛级别的数学推理能力，要求模型能够将数学洞察力与精确的多步计算相结合。

sents.en: AIME 25 ( math-ai, 2025 ) : AIME 25 comprises 30 problems from the 2025 American Invitational Mathematics Examination, covering algebra, geometry, number theory, and combinatorics.

sents.en: Its integer-answer problems evaluate competition-level mathematical reasoning, requiring models to combine mathematical insights with precise multi-step calculations.
sents.zh: 其整数答案类题目旨在评估竞赛级别的数学推理能力，要求模型能够将数学洞察力与精确的多步计算相结合。

paragraphs.en: AIME 26 ( MathArena, 2026 ) : AIME 26 contains 30 problems from the 2026 American Invitational Mathematics Examination, following the same competition format as AIME 25. It provides a complementary assessment of mathematical problem solving across a separate annual problem set, testing sustained reasoning and accurate numerical derivation.
paragraphs.zh: AIME 26（MathArena，2026）：AIME 26 包含 2026 年美国邀请数学竞赛的 30 道题目，采用与 AIME 25 相同的竞赛形式。 它通过一套独立的年度题目集，对数学问题解决能力进行补充性评估，考察持续推理和精确数值推导的能力。

paragraphs.en: MATH500 ( HuggingFaceH4, 2023 ) : MATH500 is a 500-problem subset of the MATH test set, spanning 7 mathematical subjects and 5 difficulty levels. It evaluates math reasoning across diverse problem types, including symbolic manipulation, geometric deduction, and numerical computation.
paragraphs.zh: MATH500 (HuggingFaceH4, 2023)：MATH500 是 MATH 测试集的一个包含 500 道题的子集，涵盖 7 个数学学科和 5 个难度等级。 它评估了涵盖多种问题类型的数学推理能力，包括符号运算、几何推导和数值计算。

paragraphs.en: GPQA-Diamond ( Rein et al., 2023 ) : GPQA-Diamond is a curated subset of 198 expert-written multiple-choice questions in biology, physics, and chemistry. Selected through expert and non-expert validation, these questions assess advanced scientific knowledge and reasoning that remain challenging for non-experts even with web access.
paragraphs.zh: GPQA-Diamond (Rein 等，2023)：GPQA-Diamond 是一个经过精心挑选的子集，包含 198 道由专家编写的生物学、物理学和化学领域的选择题。 这些问题通过专家和非专家的验证被筛选出来，旨在评估高级科学知识和推理能力，这些能力即使借助网络资源，对非专家而言仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: MedQA ( Yang et al., 2024 ) : MedQA is a multiple-choice question-answering benchmark derived from professional medical licensing examinations. The dataset contains 300 questions in total. Its questions assess medical knowledge and clinical reasoning, requiring models to interpret patient information and identify appropriate diagnoses, investigations, or treatments.
paragraphs.zh: MedQA（Yang 等人，2024）：MedQA 是一个源自专业医学执照考试的选择题问答基准数据集。 该数据集共包含 300 个问题。 其问题用于评估医学知识和临床推理能力，要求模型能够解读患者信息，并确定合适的诊断、检查或治疗方案。

paragraphs.en: MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) : MuSiQue is a multi-hop question-answering benchmark constructed by composing single-hop questions into connected reasoning chains of two to four hops. (2025b) , we use 200 test-set questions for downstream evaluation across all methods.

paragraphs.en: General AI Assistants (GAIA) ( Mialon et al., 2024 ) : GAIA evaluates general-purpose assistants on real-world questions involving reasoning, web browsing, information processing, and external tool use.
