sents.zh: 其多项选择题和简答题旨在评估对高级学科知识的掌握程度以及推理能力，这些问题经过精心设计，无法通过直接的网络检索快速作答。

paragraphs.en: WebWalker ( Wu et al., 2025 ) : WebWalkerQA, referred to as WebWalker in our evaluations, is an agentic search benchmark requiring exploration of website subpages and integration of information from one or multiple sources. Its easy, medium, and hard categories reflect increasing traversal depth, testing the ability to locate and synthesize evidence beyond surface-level search results.
paragraphs.zh: WebWalker（Wu 等人，2025）：WebWalkerQA 在我们的评估中被称为 WebWalker，是一种智能体搜索基准测试，要求探索网站的子页面，并整合来自一个或多个来源的信息。 其简单、中等和困难类别分别反映了逐步增加的遍历深度，用于测试超越表层搜索结果定位和综合证据的能力。

sents.en: WebWalker ( Wu et al., 2025 ) : WebWalkerQA, referred to as WebWalker in our evaluations, is an agentic search benchmark requiring exploration of website subpages and integration of information from one or multiple sources.
sents.zh: WebWalker（Wu 等人，2025）：WebWalkerQA 在我们的评估中被称为 WebWalker，是一种智能体搜索基准测试，要求探索网站的子页面，并整合来自一个或多个来源的信息。

sents.en: Its easy, medium, and hard categories reflect increasing traversal depth, testing the ability to locate and synthesize evidence beyond surface-level search results.
sents.zh: 其简单、中等和困难类别分别反映了逐步增加的遍历深度，用于测试超越表层搜索结果定位和综合证据的能力。

paragraphs.en: SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) : SealQA evaluates search-augmented question answering on factual questions for which retrieved information may be noisy, conflicting, or unhelpful. We evaluate on Seal-0 and Seal-Hard, which test factual accuracy and reasoning under challenging retrieval conditions. Seal-0 targets questions selected for near-zero accuracy among the non-reasoning models used during benchmark construction; Seal-Hard includes a broader collection of difficult questions.
paragraphs.zh: SealQA（Pham 等人，2026）：SealQA 评估在事实性问题上的搜索增强型问答能力，这些问题中检索到的信息可能存在噪声、相互冲突或无助于回答。 我们在 Seal-0 和 Seal-Hard 上进行评估，这两个数据集用于测试在具有挑战性的检索条件下模型的事实准确性与推理能力。 Seal-0 针对的是在基准构建过程中所用非推理模型中准确率接近零的问题；Seal-Hard 则包含更广泛的一系列难题。

sents.en: SealQA ( Pham et al., 2026 ) : SealQA evaluates search-augmented question answering on factual questions for which retrieved information may be noisy, conflicting, or unhelpful.
sents.zh: SealQA（Pham 等人，2026）：SealQA 评估在事实性问题上的搜索增强型问答能力，这些问题中检索到的信息可能存在噪声、相互冲突或无助于回答。

sents.en: We evaluate on Seal-0 and Seal-Hard, which test factual accuracy and reasoning under challenging retrieval conditions.
sents.zh: 我们在 Seal-0 和 Seal-Hard 上进行评估，这两个数据集用于测试在具有挑战性的检索条件下模型的事实准确性与推理能力。

sents.en: Seal-0 targets questions selected for near-zero accuracy among the non-reasoning models used during benchmark construction; Seal-Hard includes a broader collection of difficult questions.
sents.zh: Seal-0 针对的是在基准构建过程中所用非推理模型中准确率接近零的问题；Seal-Hard 则包含更广泛的一系列难题。

paragraphs.en: DeepSearchQA (DSQA) ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) : DeepSearchQA evaluates multi-step web research through tasks that require assembling complete answer sets from information distributed across sources. It tests search planning, evidence aggregation, entity disambiguation, and the ability to determine when sufficient information has been collected. We report both full-correct rate and F1 score to assess complete task success and the balance between answer precision and coverage.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSearchQA (DSQA) (Gupta 等，2026)：DeepSearchQA 通过需要整合分布于不同来源信息中的完整答案集的任务，来评估多步骤网络研究能力。 它检验了搜索规划、证据聚合、实体消歧以及判断何时已收集足够信息的能力。 我们报告了完全正确率和 F1 分数，以评估任务的整体成功程度以及答案精确度与覆盖范围之间的平衡。

sents.en: DeepSearchQA (DSQA) ( Gupta et al., 2026 ) : DeepSearchQA evaluates multi-step web research through tasks that require assembling complete answer sets from information distributed across sources.
sents.zh: DeepSearchQA (DSQA) (Gupta 等，2026)：DeepSearchQA 通过需要整合分布于不同来源信息中的完整答案集的任务，来评估多步骤网络研究能力。

sents.en: It tests search planning, evidence aggregation, entity disambiguation, and the ability to determine when sufficient information has been collected.
sents.zh: 它检验了搜索规划、证据聚合、实体消歧以及判断何时已收集足够信息的能力。

sents.en: We report both full-correct rate and F1 score to assess complete task success and the balance between answer precision and coverage.
sents.zh: 我们报告了完全正确率和 F1 分数，以评估任务的整体成功程度以及答案精确度与覆盖范围之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of HybridAgent, we compare with 4 categories of methods, including (i) Text-based Agentic Methods, (ii) Latent Reasoning Methods, (iii) Frontier LLM Agents, and (iv) Agentic Frameworks. We describe the implementation details of each baseline below.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估 HybridAgent 的有效性和效率，我们将其与 4 类方法进行了比较，包括：(i) 基于文本的智能体方法、(ii) 潜在推理方法、(iii) 前沿 LLM 智能体以及 (iv) 智能体框架。 我们在下文描述了每个基线方法的实现细节。

sents.en: To evaluate the effectiveness and efficiency of HybridAgent, we compare with 4 categories of methods, including (i) Text-based Agentic Methods, (ii) Latent Reasoning Methods, (iii) Frontier LLM Agents, and (iv) Agentic Frameworks.
sents.zh: 为了评估 HybridAgent 的有效性和效率，我们将其与 4 类方法进行了比较，包括：(i) 基于文本的智能体方法、(ii) 潜在推理方法、(iii) 前沿 LLM 智能体以及 (iv) 智能体框架。

sents.en: We describe the implementation details of each baseline below.
sents.zh: 我们在下文描述了每个基线方法的实现细节。

paragraphs.en: Standard Text SFT : We apply standard SFT using the same training data and backbone models as HybridAgent. During evaluation, the models can invoke tools and incorporate the returned observations into subsequent reasoning. We use this baseline mostly to compare with the HybridSFT.
paragraphs.zh: 标准文本 SFT：我们使用与 HybridAgent 相同的训练数据和基础模型来应用标准 SFT。 在评估过程中，模型可以调用工具，并将返回的观察结果整合到后续推理中。 我们主要使用这一基线模型与 HybridSFT 进行比较。

sents.en: Standard Text SFT : We apply standard SFT using the same training data and backbone models as HybridAgent.
sents.zh: 标准文本 SFT：我们使用与 HybridAgent 相同的训练数据和基础模型来应用标准 SFT。

sents.en: During evaluation, the models can invoke tools and incorporate the returned observations into subsequent reasoning.
sents.zh: 在评估过程中，模型可以调用工具，并将返回的观察结果整合到后续推理中。

sents.en: We use this baseline mostly to compare with the HybridSFT.
sents.zh: 我们主要使用这一基线模型与 HybridSFT 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Agentic RL (GRPO/ARPO) : We apply commonly adopted agentic RL methods after standard text SFT to further train the text agent baselines. GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) optimizes the policy using group-normalized rewards from sampled responses without requiring a separate critic. ARPO ( Dong et al., 2025b ) : ARPO combines entropy-guided adaptive rollouts with step-level advantage attribution to improve multi-turn tool use. We train these methods using the same RL training data and backbone models as HybridAgent, primarily to evaluate the effectiveness of HybridRL.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体强化学习（GRPO/ARPO）：在标准文本 SFT 之后，我们应用了广泛采用的智能体强化学习方法，以进一步训练文本智能体基线模型。 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）通过利用采样响应获得的组归一化奖励来优化策略，而无需单独的批评者模型。 ARPO（Dong 等人，2025b）：ARPO 将熵引导的自适应展开与步骤级优势归因相结合，以改进多轮工具使用。 我们使用与 HybridAgent 相同的强化学习训练数据和基础模型来训练这些方法，主要目的是评估 HybridRL 的有效性。

sents.en: Agentic RL (GRPO/ARPO) : We apply commonly adopted agentic RL methods after standard text SFT to further train the text agent baselines.
sents.zh: 智能体强化学习（GRPO/ARPO）：在标准文本 SFT 之后，我们应用了广泛采用的智能体强化学习方法，以进一步训练文本智能体基线模型。

sents.en: GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) optimizes the policy using group-normalized rewards from sampled responses without requiring a separate critic.
sents.zh: GRPO（Shao 等人，2024）通过利用采样响应获得的组归一化奖励来优化策略，而无需单独的批评者模型。

sents.en: ARPO ( Dong et al., 2025b ) : ARPO combines entropy-guided adaptive rollouts with step-level advantage attribution to improve multi-turn tool use.
sents.zh: ARPO（Dong 等人，2025b）：ARPO 将熵引导的自适应展开与步骤级优势归因相结合，以改进多轮工具使用。

sents.en: We train these methods using the same RL training data and backbone models as HybridAgent, primarily to evaluate the effectiveness of HybridRL.
sents.zh: 我们使用与 HybridAgent 相同的强化学习训练数据和基础模型来训练这些方法，主要目的是评估 HybridRL 的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Coconut ( Hao et al., 2024 ) : Coconut performs continuous latent reasoning by directly feeding the model’s last hidden state back as the next input embedding. A staged training curriculum progressively replaces textual reasoning steps with latent thoughts, teaching the model to reason in continuous space before generating a textual answer.
paragraphs.zh: Coconut (Hao 等，2024)：Coconut 通过将模型的最后隐藏状态直接作为下一个输入嵌入反馈，实现持续的潜在推理。 分阶段训练课程逐步用潜在思维取代文本推理步骤，教导模型在生成文本答案之前先进行连续空间中的推理。

sents.en: Coconut ( Hao et al., 2024 ) : Coconut performs continuous latent reasoning by directly feeding the model’s last hidden state back as the next input embedding.
sents.zh: Coconut (Hao 等，2024)：Coconut 通过将模型的最后隐藏状态直接作为下一个输入嵌入反馈，实现持续的潜在推理。

sents.en: A staged training curriculum progressively replaces textual reasoning steps with latent thoughts, teaching the model to reason in continuous space before generating a textual answer.
sents.zh: 分阶段训练课程逐步用潜在思维取代文本推理步骤，教导模型在生成文本答案之前先进行连续空间中的推理。

paragraphs.en: SoftCoT ( Xu et al., 2025b ) : SoftCoT uses a lightweight frozen assistant model to generate question-dependent soft thought representations, which a trainable projection maps into the target LLM’s representation space. These representations guide subsequent generation, enabling latent reasoning while keeping the assistant and target LLM frozen.
paragraphs.zh: SoftCoT（Xu 等人，2025b）：SoftCoT 使用一个轻量级的冻结助手模型来生成与问题相关的软思考表示，并通过一个可训练的投影将其映射到目标 LLM 的表示空间中。 这些表示会引导后续的生成过程，从而在保持助手模型和目标 LLM 冻结的同时实现潜在推理。

sents.en: SoftCoT ( Xu et al., 2025b ) : SoftCoT uses a lightweight frozen assistant model to generate question-dependent soft thought representations, which a trainable projection maps into the target LLM’s representation space.
sents.zh: SoftCoT（Xu 等人，2025b）：SoftCoT 使用一个轻量级的冻结助手模型来生成与问题相关的软思考表示，并通过一个可训练的投影将其映射到目标 LLM 的表示空间中。

sents.en: These representations guide subsequent generation, enabling latent reasoning while keeping the assistant and target LLM frozen.
sents.zh: 这些表示会引导后续的生成过程，从而在保持助手模型和目标 LLM 冻结的同时实现潜在推理。

paragraphs.en: SoftThinking ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) : SoftThinking is a context-based method that represents intermediate reasoning as probability-weighted mixtures of vocabulary embeddings. Feeding these hidden continuous representations back into the model preserves alternatives from the next-token distribution.
paragraphs.zh: SoftThinking（Zhang 等人，2025）：SoftThinking 是一种基于上下文的方法，它将中间推理表示为词汇嵌入的概率加权混合。 将这些隐式连续表示反馈到模型中，可以保留下一词分布中的其他可能性。

sents.en: SoftThinking ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) : SoftThinking is a context-based method that represents intermediate reasoning as probability-weighted mixtures of vocabulary embeddings.
sents.zh: SoftThinking（Zhang 等人，2025）：SoftThinking 是一种基于上下文的方法，它将中间推理表示为词汇嵌入的概率加权混合。

sents.en: Feeding these hidden continuous representations back into the model preserves alternatives from the next-token distribution.
sents.zh: 将这些隐式连续表示反馈到模型中，可以保留下一词分布中的其他可能性。

paragraphs.en: We implement all latent reasoning baselines using the same backbone models and, where applicable, training settings and budgets as HybridAgent to ensure a fair comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用相同的骨干模型来实现所有潜在推理基线方法，并在适用情况下采用与 HybridAgent 相同的训练设置和预算，以确保比较的公平性。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate HybridAgent in a broader context, we compare it with current leading closed-source and open-source LLM agents, including GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Kimi-K3 ( Team, 2026 ) , GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM-5-Team and others, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and QwQ-32B ( Team, 2025 ) , to assess both performance and inference efficiency of HybridAgent.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在更广泛的背景下评估 HybridAgent，我们将其与当前主流的闭源和开源 LLM 智能体进行比较，包括 GPT-5.6-Luna（OpenAI，2026）、Kimi-K3（团队，2026）、GLM-5.3-Flash（GLM-5-团队等，2026）、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（DeepSeek-AI，2026）以及 QwQ-32B（团队，2025），以评估 HybridAgent 的性能和推理效率。

paragraphs.en: We further compare HybridAgent with established agentic frameworks that integrate multi-step reasoning with external tool calling and environmental interactions. We apply Qwen3-14B as the backbone for all these frameworks, with the same tool access and usage budgets as HybridAgent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步将 HybridAgent 与现有的智能体框架进行了比较，这些框架将多步推理与外部工具调用及环境交互相结合。 我们将 Qwen3-14B 用作所有这些框架的基模，并为其提供了与 HybridAgent 相同的工具访问权限和使用时限。

sents.en: We further compare HybridAgent with established agentic frameworks that integrate multi-step reasoning with external tool calling and environmental interactions.
sents.zh: 我们进一步将 HybridAgent 与现有的智能体框架进行了比较，这些框架将多步推理与外部工具调用及环境交互相结合。

sents.en: We apply Qwen3-14B as the backbone for all these frameworks, with the same tool access and usage budgets as HybridAgent.
sents.zh: 我们将 Qwen3-14B 用作所有这些框架的基模，并为其提供了与 HybridAgent 相同的工具访问权限和使用时限。

paragraphs.en: ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) : ReAct interleaves natural-language reasoning with actions and observations from an external environment. This interaction loop allows an agent to gather information, revise its reasoning, and determine subsequent actions based on tool feedback.
paragraphs.zh: ReAct（Yao 等人，2023）：ReAct 将自然语言推理与来自外部环境的动作和观察结果交替进行。 这种交互循环使智能体能够收集信息、修正其推理，并根据工具反馈决定后续动作。

sents.en: ReAct ( Yao et al., 2023 ) : ReAct interleaves natural-language reasoning with actions and observations from an external environment.
sents.zh: ReAct（Yao 等人，2023）：ReAct 将自然语言推理与来自外部环境的动作和观察结果交替进行。

sents.en: This interaction loop allows an agent to gather information, revise its reasoning, and determine subsequent actions based on tool feedback.
sents.zh: 这种交互循环使智能体能够收集信息、修正其推理，并根据工具反馈决定后续动作。

paragraphs.en: Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) : Search-o1 augments large reasoning models with adaptive search to address knowledge gaps encountered during reasoning. Its Reason-in-Documents module analyzes retrieved documents and extracts relevant evidence before incorporating it into ongoing reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: Search-o1（Li 等人，2025a）：Search-o1 通过引入自适应搜索来增强大型推理模型，以解决推理过程中遇到的知识空白问题。 其“文档内推理”模块会分析检索到的文档，并在将其整合到正在进行的推理过程之前提取相关证据。

sents.en: Search-o1 ( Li et al., 2025a ) : Search-o1 augments large reasoning models with adaptive search to address knowledge gaps encountered during reasoning.
sents.zh: Search-o1（Li 等人，2025a）：Search-o1 通过引入自适应搜索来增强大型推理模型，以解决推理过程中遇到的知识空白问题。

sents.en: Its Reason-in-Documents module analyzes retrieved documents and extracts relevant evidence before incorporating it into ongoing reasoning.
sents.zh: 其“文档内推理”模块会分析检索到的文档，并在将其整合到正在进行的推理过程之前提取相关证据。

paragraphs.en: WebThinker ( Li et al., 2025b ) : WebThinker equips LLMs with a Deep Web Explorer that supports iterative search, webpage navigation, and information extraction. Its Think-Search-and-Draft strategy interleaves reasoning, evidence collection, and report generation to support complex research tasks.
paragraphs.zh: WebThinker（Li 等人，2025b）：WebThinker 为 LLM 配备了深度网络探索器，支持迭代搜索、网页导航和信息提取。 其“思考-搜索-起草”策略将推理、证据收集与报告生成交替进行，以支持复杂的研究任务。

sents.en: WebThinker ( Li et al., 2025b ) : WebThinker equips LLMs with a Deep Web Explorer that supports iterative search, webpage navigation, and information extraction.
sents.zh: WebThinker（Li 等人，2025b）：WebThinker 为 LLM 配备了深度网络探索器，支持迭代搜索、网页导航和信息提取。

sents.en: Its Think-Search-and-Draft strategy interleaves reasoning, evidence collection, and report generation to support complex research tasks.
sents.zh: 其“思考-搜索-起草”策略将推理、证据收集与报告生成交替进行，以支持复杂的研究任务。

paragraphs.en: Overall, these baseline methods provide complementary comparisons across training stages, text-based and latent-space reasoning, and tool-integrated agentic settings.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，这些基线方法为训练阶段、基于文本和潜在空间的推理，以及集成工具的智能体设置提供了相互补充的比较。

paragraphs.en: Models and Training Details. We instantiate HybridAgent with Qwen3-Base backbones ( Yang et al., 2025a ) at three scales of 4B, 8B, and 14B. For HybridLink, we use the same two-layer design across all three backbones. The HybridSFT training data is constructed by converting 54K text-only sources ( Dong et al., 2025a ; Dong et al., 2025b ) into hybrid trajectories. We apply format and HybridLink activation for one epoch each, followed by one additional epoch of self-conditioned training. HybridRL training utilizes 12K deep reasoning examples ( Yu et al., 2025 ) for math and 1K agentic reasoning and search examples ( Dong et al., 2025b ) for deep search. We train HybridAgent with the GRPO objective and set rollout batches of 512 trajectories ( 64 × 8 64\times 8 ), followed by one optimization pass over 8 minibatches.
paragraphs.zh: 模型与训练细节。 我们使用 Qwen3-Base 基础模型（Yang et al., 2025a）的 4B、8B 和 14B 三种规模来实例化 HybridAgent。 对于 HybridLink，我们在所有三种基础模型中都采用了相同的两层设计。 HybridSFT 训练数据通过将 5.4 万条纯文本来源（Dong et al., 2025a；Dong et al., 2025b）转换为混合轨迹构建而成。 我们对格式和 HybridLink 激活分别进行一个训练周期的训练，随后再进行一个额外的自条件训练周期。 HybridRL 训练使用了 1.2 万个深度推理示例（Yu et al., 2025）用于数学任务，以及 1000 个智能体推理与搜索示例（Dong et al., 2025b）用于深度搜索。 我们使用 GRPO 目标函数训练 HybridAgent，并将展开批次设置为 512 条轨迹（64 × 8），随后对 8 个小批量进行一次优化。

sents.en: Models and Training Details.
sents.zh: 模型与训练细节。

sents.en: We instantiate HybridAgent with Qwen3-Base backbones ( Yang et al., 2025a ) at three scales of 4B, 8B, and 14B.
sents.zh: 我们使用 Qwen3-Base 基础模型（Yang et al., 2025a）的 4B、8B 和 14B 三种规模来实例化 HybridAgent。

sents.en: For HybridLink, we use the same two-layer design across all three backbones.
sents.zh: 对于 HybridLink，我们在所有三种基础模型中都采用了相同的两层设计。

sents.en: The HybridSFT training data is constructed by converting 54K text-only sources ( Dong et al., 2025a ; Dong et al., 2025b ) into hybrid trajectories.
sents.zh: HybridSFT 训练数据通过将 5.4 万条纯文本来源（Dong et al., 2025a；Dong et al., 2025b）转换为混合轨迹构建而成。

sents.en: We apply format and HybridLink activation for one epoch each, followed by one additional epoch of self-conditioned training.
sents.zh: 我们对格式和 HybridLink 激活分别进行一个训练周期的训练，随后再进行一个额外的自条件训练周期。

sents.en: HybridRL training utilizes 12K deep reasoning examples ( Yu et al., 2025 ) for math and 1K agentic reasoning and search examples ( Dong et al., 2025b ) for deep search.
sents.zh: HybridRL 训练使用了 1.2 万个深度推理示例（Yu et al., 2025）用于数学任务，以及 1000 个智能体推理与搜索示例（Dong et al., 2025b）用于深度搜索。

sents.en: We train HybridAgent with the GRPO objective and set rollout batches of 512 trajectories ( 64 × 8 64\times 8 ), followed by one optimization pass over 8 minibatches.

paragraphs.en: Training Hyperparameters. Table 10 , 11 , and 12 provide detailed parameter setups on HybridSFT and HybridRL. Following Dong et al. (2025b) ; Yu et al. (2025) , we use HybridAgent checkpoints from deep reasoning training for mathematical evaluations and the checkpoint from agentic search training for knowledge-intensive search and agentic reasoning evaluations, as detailed in Appendix H.1 .

paragraphs.en: Inference Setups. During inference, we set the temperature, top-p, and top-k to 0.6, 0.95, and 20, respectively. The generation budget is adjusted for each task based on its relative difficulty and counts both text tokens and latent steps, with limits of 4,096 for mathematical reasoning and knowledge-intensive search tasks, and 24,000 for challenging agentic reasoning tasks. For each latent span, we enforce a minimum of 16 and a maximum of 256 steps to ensure sustained and semantically rich latent reasoning. HybridAgent interacts with external environments primarily through two types of tools: a Python interpreter within sandbox environments and a live search engine (e.g., Tavily). We cap tool usage at 10 calls per trajectory and retrieve the top 10 snippets for each search query. We utilize GPT-5.6-Luna as both the search-page summarizer and LLM judge. All training and inference are conducted on 32 H100 GPUs. We also provide detailed prompt templates in Appendix I .
paragraphs.zh: 推理设置。 在推理过程中，我们将温度、top-p 和 top-k 分别设置为 0.6、0.95 和 20。 每个任务的生成预算会根据其相对难度进行调整，同时计算文本令牌和潜在步骤的数量；数学推理和知识密集型搜索任务的限额为 4,096，而具有挑战性的智能体推理任务的限额为 24,000。 对于每个潜在跨度，我们强制执行至少 16 步、最多 256 步，以确保持续且语义丰富的潜在推理。 HybridAgent 主要通过两种工具与外部环境交互：沙盒环境中的 Python 解释器和实时搜索引擎（例如 Tavily）。 我们将工具使用次数限制为每条轨迹 10 次调用，并为每个搜索查询检索前 10 个片段。 我们将 GPT-5.6-Luna 同时用作搜索页面摘要生成器和 LLM 评判器。 所有训练和推理均在 32 块 H100 GPU 上进行。 我们还在附录 I 中提供了详细的提示模板。

paragraphs.en: Infrastructure and Configurations. As existing training and inference frameworks such as verl ( Sheng et al., 2025 ) and vLLM ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) do not directly support multi-turn hybrid generation, we extend their infrastructure to enable hybrid training and generation in HybridAgent. A shared generation loop coordinates text mode, latent mode, and tool interaction while maintaining each trajectory’s persistent KV cache as continuous working memory across turns. The agent enters latent mode through the special entry anchor <latent> , feeds HybridLink-generated latent inputs back into the backbone, and returns to text mode when the nearest-token readout matches the exit anchor </latent> , as in Eq. 5 . Tool observations are tokenized and processed against the existing working memory, appending new KV entries without reconstructing or re-prefilling earlier context.
paragraphs.zh: 基础设施与配置。 由于现有的训练和推理框架（如 verl (Sheng et al., 2025) 和 vLLM (Kwon et al., 2023)）并不直接支持多轮混合生成，我们扩展了这些框架的基础设施，以便在 HybridAgent 中实现混合训练与生成。 一个共享的生成循环负责协调文本模式、潜在模式和工具交互，同时保持每条轨迹的持久 KV 缓存作为跨轮次延续的工作记忆。 智能体通过特殊入口锚点 <latent> 进入潜在模式，将 HybridLink 生成的潜在输入回传至主干模型，并在最近邻 token 的读取结果匹配出口锚点 </latent> 时返回文本模式，如公式 5 所示。 工具观察结果会被分词并处理以匹配现有工作记忆，新增 KV 条目而无需重建或重新预填充早期上下文。

paragraphs.en: The engine also supports batched rollouts with per-sequence state tracking, allowing trajectories to occupy different generation states within the same batch. Pending tool calls execute concurrently, with waiting and completed sequences masked from further generation. Per-sequence attention masks and position tracking preserve each trajectory’s causal context as generation proceeds. For HybridRL, exact latent-context replay recomputes sampled text-token likelihoods in a single differentiable forward pass while keeping recorded latent inputs unchanged. We check rollout–replay agreement of log-probabilities at unchanged policy parameters. Multi-node data parallelism, sharded optimizer states, mixed precision, gradient checkpointing, and resumable checkpoints support full-parameter backbone optimization. Overall, the same engine supports RL rollouts, training-time validation, and downstream evaluation, ensuring consistent mode transitions and working-memory handling across configurable sampling settings, generation budgets, and tool-call setups.
paragraphs.zh: 该引擎还支持批量推理，并具备每序列状态跟踪功能，使得同一批次内的不同轨迹可以处于不同的生成状态。 待执行的工具调用会并发执行，而正在等待和已完成的序列则会被屏蔽，不参与后续生成。 每序列的注意力掩码和位置跟踪机制可在生成过程中保留各轨迹的因果上下文。 对于 HybridRL，精确的潜在上下文重播会在单次可微分的前向传播中重新计算采样文本标记的概率，同时保持已记录的潜在输入不变。 我们在策略参数不变的情况下，验证推理与重播之间的对数概率一致性。 多节点数据并行、分片优化器状态、混合精度、梯度检查点以及可恢复的检查点机制，共同支持全参数主干网络的优化。 总体而言，同一引擎支持强化学习推理、训练时的验证以及下游评估，确保在不同采样设置、生成预算和工具调用配置下，模式切换与工作内存处理保持一致性。
